jobs.job_description_raw: Director, Technology Adoption, Engagement & Transformation — China Role Snapshot Function / Team: Commercial Excellence & Innovation (CEI) - Digital & Technology (Technology Adoption, Engagement & Transformation) Location: China Grade / Level: Director Reports to: Digital & Technology Head (D&T Head) 1. Role Summary The Director leads the market-facing technology adoption, engagement and transformation capability for CEI Digital & Technology. The role ensures existing systems and new AI-enabled products are directed toward measurable outcomes, CEI PODs are formed around clear opportunities, and adoption and transformation continue through scale and sustainable ownership. 2. Key Accountabilities Translate CEI and Business Unit priorities into an integrated technology adoption, roadmap, demand and portfolio agenda aligned with global D&T. Own senior technology engagement and transformation for legacy and AI-enabled products and carry market signals into intake, prioritization and POD formation. Lead technology product and portfolio lifecycle decisions using reuse-before-build and operate, modernize, industrialize or retire choices. Shape business and operating-model transformation by connecting technology, workflow redesign, change, adoption and value realization. Lead experience and workflow design across customer and colleague journeys, user experience, agent hand-offs and Business Unit adaptation. Establish adoption telemetry, service integration and an integrated service catalogue, using platform usage and user insight to improve adoption and outcomes. Coordinate Legal, Privacy, Risk, Compliance and Security clearance as lifecycle stage gates and provide a clear D&T liaison for governance stakeholders. Lead technology scouting and assess emerging technologies for strategic relevance and business value. Enable POD effectiveness through clear outcomes, product ownership, stakeholder alignment, adoption planning and transition to sustainable ownership. Own the market-facing engagement model for CEI D&T — running a structured operating rhythm with Business Units and CEI capabilities to surface demand, align priorities and drive adoption of technology and AI-enabled products. 3. Required Capabilities & Competencies (a) Critical Capabilities & Qualifications Technology stack and adoption, business engagement, transformation leadership, product and portfolio lifecycle and executive stakeholder management. Experience and workflow design, adoption and change, telemetry, service integration and technology scouting. Legal, privacy, risk and compliance coordination, POD operating models and value realization. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Digital Business or Design or a closely related discipline; an advanced technical or business degree is preferred. Typically, 15+ years of progressive relevant experience, including several years leading teams and delivery at scope and complexity appropriate to similar level. Demonstrated ability to work across business, product, technology, data and governance stakeholders in a matrixed environment. Experience in a highly regulated industry and the China technology, data, privacy or vendor environment is preferred. (b) Leadership Expectations Outcome ownership: connects decisions to measurable business, user, service and transformation outcomes. AI-first and enterprise-minded: applies responsible AI, reuse, architecture, security, privacy and scale principles appropriate to the work. POD collaboration: enables clear accountability, effective cross-functional execution and minimal handoff friction across peer teams and partners. Precision and learning: communicate clearly, documents decisions, uses evidence and telemetry and continuously improves delivery. Transformation leadership: connects business ambition, experience, adoption, portfolio choices and measurable value realization. 4. Key Collaboration The Director maintains strong partnership with Go-to-Market Transformation (GTMx), AI transformation office (AITO), Global Commercial Analytics (GCA) and the Chief Marketing Office (CMO), Pfizer Innovation Center (PIC), China Business Units or functions, and peer D&T team leads, carrying market signals into intake, prioritization and POD formation. The role provides a clear D&T liaison for Legal, Privacy, Risk, Compliance and Security governance stakeholders, and works with relevant global D&T teams. It also partners with China CEI leadership and POD owners to align technology portfolio and transformation with commercial priorities. 5. Measures of Success Clear alignment of technology portfolio and investment with CEI and Business Unit priorities. Higher adoption and measurable value from legacy and AI-enabled products. Effective POD initiation, stakeholder alignment and transition into scale and sustainable ownership. Timely governance clearance and improved product lifecycle discipline, user experience and workflow outcomes. jobs.job_description_raw: Position Summary The GE Marketing Lead - Metabolism is responsible for driving the strategic planning, launch excellence, and long-term growth of Pfizer's metabolic portfolio across broad-market China, with a primary focus on diabetes, obesity diseases. This role will lead the development and execution of innovative go-to-market strategies, accelerate market access and HCP engagement, build scalable healthcare ecosystem platforms, and ensure strong cross-functional collaboration to maximize business impact. The position requires deep expertise in metabolic diseases and demonstrated success in launching or managing diabetes, obesity, GLP-1RA, or related cardiometabolic brands. Key Responsibilities 1. Portfolio Strategy & Brand Leadership Lead strategic planning and lifecycle management of the metabolic portfolio. Develop annual business plans, launch strategies, and growth initiatives aligned with business objectives. Identify market opportunities through customer, patient, competitor, and policy insights. Translate brand strategy into actionable field execution plans and measurable business outcomes. 2. Launch Excellence & Go-to-Market Development Drive successful launch and commercialization of innovative metabolic products. Design differentiated go-to-market models for broad-market and county-level healthcare settings. Build customer engagement strategies across Endocrinology, General Practice, Nutrition, Obesity Management, and other relevant specialties. Develop scalable models to accelerate adoption, access, and physician preference. 3. Healthcare Ecosystem & Platform Building Lead development of strategic healthcare ecosystem initiatives, including PPP and disease management platforms. Establish partnerships with key hospitals, academic societies, and healthcare stakeholders. Promote integrated patient management pathways for diabetes and obesity care. Generate real-world experience and best-practice models to support long-term brand growth. 4. Cross-functional Leadership Partner closely with Medical, Access, Sales, Commercial Excellence, Digital, and other teams. Ensure One Pfizer collaboration to align resources and accelerate business execution. Drive operational excellence, resource prioritization, and ROI optimization. 5. Market Insights & Performance Management Monitor competitive landscape, reimbursement policies, and market dynamics. Utilize data analytics to identify growth opportunities and guide investment decisions. Define and track key business KPIs, including: Market share growth Hospital access expansion Physician adoption Patient initiation Brand awareness and preference Real-world evidence generation 6. Team Leadership & Talent Development Build and develop a high-performing marketing organization. Coach and mentor team members to strengthen strategic thinking and execution capabilities. Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and accountability. Qualifications Education Bachelor's degree or above in Medicine, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Public Health, Business, or related disciplines. MBA or advanced healthcare-related degree preferred. Experience Minimum 8-10 years of pharmaceutical industry experience. Mandatory Therapeutic Area Expertise Strong metabolic disease background is required , including demonstrated experience in one or more of the following areas: Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) Obesity / Chronic Weight Management (CWM) GLP-1 Receptor Agonists Endocrinology Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. jobs.job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递 / 沟通 / 反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 1. 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 2. 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 3. 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 4. 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 5. 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 6. 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 7. 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会。 8. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 · 教育： - 具有医学、药学或相关专业大学专科及以上学历。 · 技能： - 熟练使用 MS Office ，英语良好。 - 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 · 经验 ： - 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 · 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA ( 《反海外腐败法》 ) 及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透 明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 · 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级 & 时限等要求。 核心能力 专业合规 : 坚持专业推广 - 掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规 - 工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断 : 把握市场动态 - 随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息 - 合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动 : 提供专业支持 - 积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作 - 对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行 : 高效准确执行 - 及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务 - 对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 自我发展 : 主动提升能力 - 把握内外部各种学习机会和资源，不断提升自身的能力和适应力。 创新变革 : 积极拥抱变化 - 用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. jobs.job_description_raw:
Job Purpose and Impact 
 The Analyst Accounting, Capital Assets & Leases APAC  job performs routine record to report activities to collect, process and present accurate financial data for the purposes of providing external information for decision making while ensuring compliance with financial transaction recording standards. Under close supervision, this job collaborates with businesses and banks to complete standard operational processes and procedures, compliance and data management for financial products and services and data systems. This job also supports improvements in process execution and audit activities.
 Key Accountabilities 
 RECORD TO REPORT ACTIVITIES: Performs routine activities, including processing journal entries and intercompany transactions, completing monthly and quarterly general ledger close activities, performing fixed asset accounting, balance sheet reconciliations and reporting activities, tax accounting, cost and profit center allocation, bank accounting and bank reconciliations. 
 FOREX RISK MANAGEMENT: Assists with foreign exchange risk management for selected units, including activities related to foreign exchange exposures, foreign exchange risks, and risk management procedures and processes to ensure adherence to policies. 
 POLICY COMPLIANCE & CONSISTENCY: Maintains the standard operating procedures and processes, and helps monitor operational compliance with financial transaction recording standards, including company accounting policies, statutory reporting regulations and tax regulations. 
 BUSINESS PARTNERSHIP: Supports positive relationship with customers, clients and other business partners, responding to business contacts or customers directly to deliver accurate processes. 
 PROCESS EXECUTION IMPROVEMENT: Applies basic knowledge of operational practices, procedures and internal controls to identify improvement opportunities in execution to drive operational excellence and data integrity to enable analysis and insight. 
 Qualifications 
 Strong knowledge of fixed asset accounting principles and processes.
 3-4 years of relevant Fixed Asset accounting experience; exceptional candidates may be considered with less experience.
 Strong communication skills, Continuous improvement mindset. 
 Korean language proficiency is a plus for this role.

Job Purpose and Impact 
 The position will provide assistance to the team for complex administrative tasks for the coordination of sourcing contract related activities by following the established guidelines. In this role, you will partner with related stakeholders to support the process of contract creations and amendments in related systems. You will collaborate with internal business and external suppliers to maintain contract data in the database to ensure compliance with appropriate guidelines.
 Key Accountabilities 
 Partner with relevant stakeholders to provide assistance on pending contract items and organize them in the database.
 Provide support to the team to ensure contract compliance with established guidelines by maintaining the mandatory items using the approved contract template and collecting queries or escalations raised.
 Collect and organize complex administrative reports on contract analysis for the defined area.
 Maintain, review and analyze operational contracts for goods and services assigned, including contract items, pricing, terms and conditions and ensure new data element is in the information systems.
 Provide assistance to assigned projects and support deployments related to sourcing contract management.
 Handle complex clerical, administrative, technical or customer support issues under minimal supervision, while escalating only the most complex issues to appropriate staff.
 Other duties as assigned
 Qualifications 
 Minimum Qualifications High school diploma, secondary education level or equivalent
 Thai & English skills
 Prefer to have procurement and SAP related experience
 Other minimum qualifications may apply

Troubleshoots and corrects process variations on systems partially with assistance from senior engineers.

jobs.job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递 / 沟通 / 反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 1. 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 2. 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 3. 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 4. 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 5. 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 6. 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 7. 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会。 8. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 · 教育： - 具有医学、药学或相关专业大学专科及以上学历。 · 技能： - 熟练使用 MS Office ，英语良好。 - 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 · 经验 ： - 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 · 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA ( 《反海外腐败法》 ) 及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透 明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 · 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级 & 时限等要求。 核心能力 专业合规 : 坚持专业推广 - 掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规 - 工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断 : 把握市场动态 - 随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息 - 合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动 : 提供专业支持 - 积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作 - 对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行 : 高效准确执行 - 及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务 - 对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 自我发展 : 主动提升能力 - 把握内外部各种学习机会和资源，不断提升自身的能力和适应力。 创新变革 : 积极拥抱变化 - 用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. Who We Are 
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. 
 What We Offer 
 Location:
Beijing,CHN, Chengdu,CHN, Dalian,CHN, Hefei,CHN, Shanghai,CHN, Shenzhen,CHN, Wuhan,CHN, Wuxi,CHN, Xi'an,CHN 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
 TSEs provide technical support remotely, and on site, to FSO personnel for highly complex problems involving equipment malfunction, on wafer issues, and performance enhancement programs where first-line product support was unable to isolate or fix a problem. Using advanced troubleshooting methodologies, they establish success criteria, develop comprehensive action plans, analyze and compile findings, perform root cause analysis and support FSO repair activities through escalation closure. 
 Responsible for technical escalations (remote & onsite) at customer sites for DDP [CVD] products, able to use a systematic approach to problem solving and use data driven troubleshooting and diagnostic tools.
 Support and provide technical feedback to improve fleet performance, improvement programs and upgrades.
 Guide and coach field engineers in troubleshooting techniques, work ethics and cultural norms.
 Develop troubleshooting guides and support technical documentation to enhance field engineers’ knowledge.
 Key Responsibilities:   
 Support multiple technical escalations, resolve with focus on time to resolution and quality of work 
 Attend customer field issues meetings with FSO, collaborate with BU engineers  
 Recommend best practices to improve products, processes, or services. 
 Publishing Technical Lessons Learned, troubleshooting guides, technical (ET) papers, etc. 
 Provide on-site coaching to FSO   
 Support NPI development early in the product life cycle, and at key customer sites 
 Create, or collaborate in creation of, innovative advanced trouble shooting tools   
 Business Expertise:   
 Has knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others; is aware of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market.  
 Leadership:   
 Provides coaching to colleagues with less experience; may lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements. 
 Problem Solving:   
 Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective on existing solutions; exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information and data. 
 Impact:   
 Impacts a range of customer, operational, project or service activities within own team and other related teams; works within broad guidelines and policies. 
 Interpersonal Skills:   
 Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus. Manage difficult situations in stressful environments. 
 Qualifications   
 1) Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in technical field   
 2) Skills
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a team
 - Strong Organizational and time management skills
 - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
 - Ability to handle stressful situations and effectively manage difficult problem
 - Familiar with suite of Microsoft Apps, and internal ones such as SAP, VSPI and ARK.
 3) Year of Experience: +7 years of experience with Applied Materials DDP products or similar.
 Additional Information 
 Travel - Generally 25% of the time, but could be as high as 50%

jobs.job_description_raw: Retail & E-commerce Metabolic Strategy & Operations Lead 零售及电商代谢战略运营负责人 Location: Beijing / Shanghai Therapy Area Focus: Overweight & Obesity (GLP-1) ROLE SUMMARY The Retail & E-commerce Metabolic Strategy & Operations Lead supports the development and execution of the overall retail and e-commerce business strategy for the metabolic portfolio. The role integrates strategic planning, business performance management, commercial insights and operational coordination to enable informed decision-making and sustainable business growth. Working closely with Retail Metabolic Marketing / Brand Managers, E-commerce Channel Teams and cross-functional stakeholders, this role translates market intelligence and business performance data into actionable priorities, strengthens strategic alignment and facilitates the delivery of key business initiatives. The role provides strategic and operational oversight, while dedicated Project Managers own day-to-day project coordination and delivery. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES • Business Strategy & Planning: Support integrated retail and e-commerce strategic planning, annual business priorities and growth opportunity assessments; translate strategic objectives into clear business plans and actionable priorities. • Business Performance Management: Establish and maintain business performance dashboards and KPI frameworks; monitor channel performance, commercial drivers and progress against business priorities, providing management with data-driven recommendations. • Market Intelligence & Strategic Insights: Analyze retail and e-commerce market dynamics, competition, channel trends, and consumer and patient journey insights to identify opportunities and inform strategic decisions. • Cross-functional Alignment & Operational Excellence: Facilitate alignment across Retail Marketing, E-commerce and relevant enabling functions; support business reviews, operational planning, resource prioritization and continuous improvement of ways of working. • Strategic Initiative Execution & Governance: Track the progress, milestones and business impact of priority strategic initiatives; help remove cross-functional barriers and maintain alignment with business objectives in collaboration with responsible project owners and Project Managers. PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS • Strategic Thinking & Structured Problem-Solving: Ability to structure ambiguous commercial questions, evaluate strategic options and convert analysis into business recommendations. • Business Planning & Performance Management: Experience supporting business strategy, commercial planning, KPI development, performance tracking and management reviews. • Retail & E-commerce Business Acumen: Strong understanding of retail and digital commerce business models, channel dynamics and commercial performance drivers; familiarity with obesity or metabolic care journeys is an advantage. • Market Intelligence & Analytical Rigor: Proven ability to synthesize market, competitive, customer and commercial data into clear, executive-ready insights. • Cross-functional Influence & Communication: Strong stakeholder management, communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority. • Execution & Operational Excellence: Ability to coordinate priorities, establish effective operating rhythms and monitor strategic initiative outcomes in a regulated business environment. Experience: • 10+ years of relevant professional experience, including 7+ years in business strategy, commercial operations, management consulting, market insights or related roles. • Healthcare or pharmaceutical industry experience strongly preferred; experience in retail and/or e-commerce channels is an advantage. • Experience with business performance analytics, strategic planning and cross-functional stakeholder engagement preferred. Education: Bachelor's degree required; an advanced degree (MBA, MS or equivalent) is preferred. Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. jobs.job_description_raw: JOB SUMMARY As the EC Customer Engagement Lead of Ali Health , you will own the metabolic business strategy, strategic platform partnerships, and overall commercial performance of the JD/Ali channel. You will shape the channel growth agenda, integrate platform and internal resources, guide the JD/Ali E-commerce Manager, and ensure compliant execution to strengthen patient access and deliver sustainable business growth. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES · Channel Strategy & Business Planning: Own metabolic channel strategy, annual and quarterly business plans, commercial priorities and channel targets, aligning platform opportunities with the retail and e-commerce business strategy. · Strategic Partnership & Resource Integration: Lead JD/Ali platform partnerships, commercial negotiations and joint business planning; secure appropriate platform resources and coordinate Marketing, Medical, Finance, Supply Chain and other relevant stakeholders. · Business Performance & Growth: Account for overall JD/Ali channel performance; monitor revenue, market share, channel effectiveness and investment efficiency, and initiate corrective actions where required. · Commercial Innovation & Patient Access: Identify compliant opportunities for new customer engagement, digital services, access pathways and commercial innovation within the JD/Ali ecosystem. · Team Leadership & Execution Oversight: Provide direction, coaching and performance guidance to the JD/Ali E-commerce Manager; oversee key commercial campaigns and ensure delivery against business priorities. · Market Intelligence & Compliance: Monitor customer, platform and competitive trends while ensuring all channel activities comply with applicable policies, laws and internal governance. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE · Bachelor's degree or above; marketing, business, healthcare or a related discipline preferred. · Typically 10+ years of relevant commercial experience, including substantial pharmaceutical/healthcare e-commerce, platform partnership or channel leadership exposure. · Demonstrated JD/Ali platform experience and strong understanding of pharmaceutical e-commerce business models, operations and regulatory requirements. · Proven ability to lead business planning, external partnerships, cross-functional alignment and commercial performance management. SKILLS REQUIREMENTS · Strong strategic thinking, business judgment, stakeholder influence and cross-functional collaboration. · Excellent communication and presentation skills in Chinese and English. · Strong execution, planning, problem-solving and adaptability in a dynamic commercial environment. INTEGRITY & COMPLIANCE Perform all responsibilities in accordance with Pfizer policies, applicable laws, industry codes and internal approval processes. Maintain integrity, transparency and appropriate handling of patient and business information. jobs.job_description_raw: JOB SUMMARY As the EC Channel Lead of Innovation Business, you will own the metabolic business strategy, strategic platform partnerships, and overall commercial performance of the channel. You will shape the channel growth agenda, integrate platform and internal resources, ensure compliant execution to strengthen patient access and deliver sustainable business growth. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES · Channel Strategy & Business Planning: Own metabolic channel strategy, annual and quarterly business plans, commercial priorities and channel targets, aligning platform opportunities with the retail and e-commerce business strategy. · Strategic Partnership & Resource Integration: Lead platform partnerships, commercial negotiations and joint business planning; secure appropriate platform resources and coordinate Marketing, Medical, Finance, Supply Chain and other relevant stakeholders. · Business Performance & Growth: Account for overall channel performance; monitor revenue, market share, channel effectiveness and investment efficiency, and initiate corrective actions where required. · Commercial Innovation & Patient Access: Identify compliant opportunities for new customer engagement, digital services, access pathways and commercial innovation within the ecosystem. · Team Leadership & Execution Oversight: Provide direction, oversee key commercial campaigns and ensure delivery against business priorities. · Market Intelligence & Compliance: Monitor customer, platform and competitive trends while ensuring all channel activities comply with applicable policies, laws and internal governance. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE · Bachelor's degree or above; marketing, business, healthcare or a related discipline preferred. · Typically 5+ years of relevant commercial experience, including substantial pharmaceutical/healthcare e-commerce, platform partnership or channel leadership exposure. · Demonstrated platform experience and strong understanding of pharmaceutical e-commerce business models, operations and regulatory requirements. · Proven ability to lead business planning, external partnerships, cross-functional alignment and commercial performance management. SKILLS REQUIREMENTS · Strong strategic thinking, business judgment, stakeholder influence and cross-functional collaboration. · Excellent communication and presentation skills in Chinese and English. · Strong execution, planning, problem-solving and adaptability in a dynamic commercial environment. INTEGRITY & COMPLIANCE Perform all responsibilities in accordance with Pfizer policies, applicable laws, industry codes and internal approval processes. Maintain integrity, transparency and appropriate handling of patient and business information. FOR INTERNAL APPLICANTS Internal applicants must meet applicable company eligibility, compliance and performance requirements. jobs.job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通大区经理负责管理所辖区域的一切业务，包括制订和实施区域的工作目标和发展计划，建立一个绩效良好、极富生产力和士气高昂的团队。对客户的需求做出适当反应以实现区域的各项工作目标。对团队成员的行为进行规范和监管，对他们的专业技能提升和学习发展规划提供辅导和支持。 主要工作和任务 1. 制订并执行所辖区域的业务计划，推动大区各个团队实现公司和上级下达的各项工作目标和任务。 2. 招聘符合公司基本要求的人员，定期对团队成员进行绩效和行为的评估，实施奖惩或激励措施。 3. 制订并执行培养团队成员合规意识的计划，规范员工的工作行为，确保各项活动的真实性和合规性。 4. 制订并执行团队成员专业知识和技能的发展计划，通过随访对团队成员定期进行教导，以加强其专业能力、产品知识、产品策略、医学信息沟通技巧和总体工作效率，并对其个人发展规划提供指导与支持。 5. 根据大区业务发展的方向进行人力资源分配和人才规划，促进区域健康良性发展，建立人才梯队，保留高绩效人才。 6. 通过跟进计划，各团队的工作汇报和和随访等，深入了解各个团队的工作进展并进行针对性的辅导，包括业务及市场活动，人员管理和辅导，人才发展和保留等工作。 7. 根据对市场发展趋势的分析，挖掘区域市场机会，打造大区的长期竞争优势。 8. 协调并组织大区内的重要项目及活动，合理分配和控制各项资源。 9. 与区域内关键客户保持持续的沟通，前瞻性预测客户学术需求的变化，建立并持续优化战略合作伙伴关系。 10. 熟悉对当前及未来业务有影响的政策，必要情况下可根据公司的要求，与相关职能部门合作，参与或协调所辖区域的市场准入工作。 11. 建立和保持有效沟通系统，包括定期召开大区会议，定期与上级汇报区域工作进展，与其他部门建立跨部门沟通和合作关系。 12. 为制订和修改业务相关的政策和流程及其他内部政策提供建议，以实现高效率的业务运作。 13. 支持公司的各项创新举措，带领大区各个团队执行新举措，搭建创新平台。 14. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 教育： - 大学本科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 技能： - 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 - 具备较好的相关产品领域的专业知识。 - 具备较强的领导力和战略思维能力。 - 具备较强的沟通，计划，组织和问题解决能力。 - 具备较强的团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 经验： - 至少 3 年制药行业同等公司的业务管理工作经验，具备符合合规要求的，优秀的绩效记录。 诚信： - jobs.job_description_raw:
Who We Are 
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
 What We Offer 
 Location:
Beijing,CHN, Chengdu,CHN, Dalian,CHN, Guangzhou,CHN, Hefei,CHN, Shanghai,CHN, Shenzhen,CHN, Xi'an,CHN 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.  
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Install, maintain, and upgrade customer equipment
 Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with assistance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] and/or the customer to understand roadmaps, process flows, inflection points, requirements, and business challenges   
 Train and mentor junior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems
 Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
 Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
 Minimum Qualifications:   
 Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification
 4-7 years of work experience in semiconductor industry or other equipment support industry
 Advanced mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, and/or thermodynamics
 Strong knowledge of hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.   Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.   
 Additional Information 
 Time Type: 
Full time 
 Employee Type: 
Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
Yes, 20% of the Time 
 Relocation Eligible: 
Yes 
 Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Who We Are 
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. 
 What We Offer 
 Location:
Shanghai,CHN 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
 Role Summary 
 This is a critical position within the AGS FSO SPO Organization, embedded in the Global Program Adoption (GPA) team. The Regional Program Adoption (RPA) enables effective adoption, sustained utilization, and productivity improvement across Field Service Operations through structured change management, field communications, and business process training.
 The RPA focuses on representing field challenges, facilitating field communication, and supporting change management through the Prosci process. Key responsibilities include driving cross-functional collaboration, supporting regional program adoption and training, communicating updates, championing process efficiencies, and resolving complex field operational issues.
 The role requires deep knowledge of Field Service Operations, AGS Operations, Sales, data analytics, and change management, with preferred qualifications including project management and change management certification, and over five years of field service experience.
 Key Focus Areas 
 1) Voice of the Field Service Operations 
 Represent regional field perspectives for SPO–sponsored programs and initiatives
 by articulating local operational realities, constraints, priorities, and cultural considerations
 Act as a bi-directional conduit between global project teams and regional field service organizations: Bring regional insights into program/project design, sequencing, rollout strategy, and readiness planning
 Translate global intent and standards into regionally relevant guidance and execution considerations
 Translate field feedback into actionable recommendations influencing project scope and deployment approach
 Advocate for solutions that improve field productivity, efficiency, and user experience within the represented region
 2) Field Communications 
 Plan and execute field-facing communications to drive awareness, understanding, and readiness for change
 Facilitate communication between global project teams and regional field organizations through multiple channels, including: Field Council and Field Engineer Info Session

You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.

 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.   Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

jobs.job_description_raw: Director, Data Engineering & Semantics — China Role Snapshot Function / Team: Commercial Excellence & Innovation (CEI) - Digital & Technology (Data Engineering & Semantics) Location: China Grade / Level: Director Reports to: Digital & Technology Head (D&T Head) 1. Role Summary The Director leads the Data Engineering & Semantics capability that provides trusted, governed and AI-ready data for analytics, digital products and AI solutions across Pfizer China commercial operations. The role owns data engineering, reporting and business intelligence foundations, knowledge and unstructured data engineering, technical semantic models, technical data quality and observability, technical data governance controls, reusable data agents, and AI Consumption Layer (AICL) delivery. It translates business definitions, harmonized KPIs, master data business rules and business data governance requirements into scalable technical solutions. This leader ensures CEI PODs work from one consistent and compliant data foundation, aligned with enterprise data standards and China data and privacy requirements. 2. Key Accountabilities Define and execute the China technical roadmap for data engineering and semantic implementation, aligned with DSM-led business requirements, CEI priorities, enterprise data strategy and global Digital & Technology standards. Lead standardized data engineering across ingestion, integration, transformation, storage and serving for structured, unstructured and knowledge data. Translate business definitions, harmonized KPIs and taxonomies into reusable semantic models, metadata and technical mappings across reporting, analytics and AI. Build reusable data products, reporting and business intelligence foundations and data agents that improve discoverability, interoperability and reuse. Own AICL technical delivery against business requirements and priorities, connecting governed data, semantic models and knowledge assets with the China LLM foundation for consistent, secure and scalable consumption by business teams and PODs. Implement technical data governance controls, lineage, observability and data quality checks based on business governance requirements; resolve technical issues and support DSM-led business stewardship. Ensure data handling meets China data, privacy and cross-border requirements, partnering with privacy, legal and compliance stakeholders. Enable AITO and CEI PODs with trusted data, technical implementation of semantic standards and data engineering specialists from MVP scoping through scale. Lead and develop data engineering, technical semantics and technical data governance talent, balancing foundation build with priority business demand. 3. Required Capabilities & Competencies (a) Critical Capabilities & Qualifications Enterprise data strategy, modern data engineering, data architecture, data products and reporting and business intelligence foundations. Semantic modeling, metadata, taxonomy and ontology; technical integration of master and reference data in line with DSM-defined business rules; and knowledge and unstructured data engineering. Technical implementation of business data governance requirements, support for business stewardship, data quality controls, lineage, observability and China data privacy and cross-border controls. Data enablement for AI, including retrieval, knowledge grounding, data access for agents, reusable data agents and AI consumption layer delivery. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems or a closely related discipline; an advanced technical or business degree is preferred. Typically 15+ years of progressive relevant experience, including several years leading teams and delivery at scope and complexity appropriate to similar level. Demonstrated ability to work across business, product, technology, data and governance stakeholders in a matrixed environment. Experience in a highly regulated industry and the China technology, data, privacy or vendor environment is preferred. (b) Leadership Expectations Outcome ownership: connects decisions to measurable business, user, service and transformation outcomes. AI-first and enterprise-minded: applies responsible AI, reuse, architecture, security, privacy and scale principles appropriate to the work. POD collaboration: enables clear accountability, effective cross-functional execution and minimal handoff friction across peer teams and partners. Precision and learning: communicates clearly, documents decisions, uses evidence and telemetry and continuously improves delivery. Talent development: grows data engineering, technical semantics and technical data governance leadership across the team. 4. Key Collaboration The Director maintains strong partnership with Go-to-Market Transformation (GTMx), AI Transformation Office (AITO), Global Commercial Analytics (GCA), Commercial Excellence (CE), Pfizer Innovation Center (PIC) and peer D&T capabilities, to connect trusted data to measurable commercial outcomes. The role works closely with AI Platform & Foundation on AICL delivery on top of the China LLM foundation, retrieval, knowledge grounding and agent data access, and with Enterprise Engineering, Deployment & Operations on production integration and support of data products. It also works with global data and analytics teams, data owners and stewards, and privacy, legal, risk and compliance stakeholders. Data Strategy Management (DSM) within GCA owns the business side of AICL, including business requirements, priorities, business acceptance and business operations, as well as KPI harmonization, master data business ownership and business data governance. This role owns the corresponding technical implementation and data engineering delivery, working with DSM on business definitions, stewardship and issue resolution. 5. Measures of Success Technical delivery quality and reuse of governed data products, semantic models and data agents, with consistent implementation of DSM-approved business definitions and harmonized KPIs. Improved data quality, lineage, observability and semantic consistency across reporting, analytics and AI. Faster POD delivery through trusted, reusable and AI-ready data foundations, timely AICL technical delivery against agreed business requirements, and reliable platform performance. Effective implementation of DSM-approved data standards and technical controls, with timely resolution of engineering issues and adherence to applicable China data and privacy requirements. jobs.normalized_title: Clinical Assay Lead, Manager (Contractor), Shanghai or Beijing
jobs.normalized_title_en: Clinical Assay Lead, Manager (Contractor), Shanghai or Beijing
jobs.location_raw: China - Shanghai - STIT / CHN - BJ - Beijing R&D Center
jobs.job_description_raw: JOB INFORMATIONJOB SUMMARY As a member of the Clinical Assay Group within Development China Clinical Pharmacology, Clinical Assay Lead will play a critical role in supporting clinical strategies in all stages of drug development and post marketing activities through scientific and technical leadership, oversight and management of external and internal partners involved in delivering quality, timely, and regulatory compliant PK, PD, immunogenicity and biomarker analytical assays and data (as relevant to Small Molecule, Biologics or biomarker). JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Serves as a member of the clinical study team and analytical subject matter expert for executing clinical study setup & conduct, contributing to the study protocol development & review, preparing submissions, addressing regulatory queries, implementing bioanalytical strategies & assays, and delivering regulatory compliant data and reports within program timelines. Leads and oversees small or large molecule PK, PD, and immunogenicity (ADA and Nab) assay and biomarker assay lifecycle management from early stage to registration. Analytical strategy execution, method design, development, and validation, as well as data quality review will be involved. Corresponds sample analyses & reports to meet evolving program objectives and regulatory expectations. Assists CROs with effective troubleshooting of the bioanalytical assay and issue resolution. Functions as key point of contact with external & internal laboratories and supports (or leads, as appropriate) selection, qualification, performance evaluation, and periodic audits of CRO laboratories conducting clinical PK, PD and immunogenicity assays (as relevant to the role). Supports the clinical trial conduct within scope of the Clinical Assay Group responsibilities, including development and review of documents and processes such as CRF and data setup, clinical site lab manual, sample management & reconciliation, bioanalytical study planning & reporting, budgeting & invoicing, compliance with clinical SOPs & policies, and regulatory inspection readiness & conduct. Contributes to the development of Best Practices, processes, templates, and policies. Maintains up-to-date knowledge of current and novel chromatographic separation/mass spectrometry based detection, ligand binding technologies & techniques or bioanalytical techniques commonly used for Biomarkers (as relevant to the role), global regulatory guidances & expectations, and industry best practices. RESOURCES MANAGED Indirect responsibility for the clinical budget allocated to bioanalytical support of the clinical study or program. Develop bioanalysis agreements with commercial and academic laboratories. Responsible for approval of invoices for work overseen. Member of HGRAC task force, Clinical sub-teams and study teams. ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS Reports to Clinical Assay Group Lead Frequent interaction with colleagues in Clinical Pharmacology, Clinicians, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), Clinical Operations, Statistics, Regulatory, Finance, and external collaborators, as appropriate. As Specific to Biomarker: Hands-on experience with the development, validation and troubleshooting of the methods commonly used for Biomarkers, including but limited to flow cytometry, FISH, IHC and NGS As Specific to Biologics: Hands-on experience with the development, validation and troubleshooting of the methods for PK and immunogenicity (including the determination of assay cut points, tolerance, and sensitivity along with experience implementing ACE, BEAD, and SPEAD methodologies) and clinical sample analysis. Understanding of critical reagent generation & lifecycle management Experience with biosimilars, gene therapy, multi-domain therapeutics, immunocapture, protein binding, cell based assays and technologies such as RT-PCR, qPCR, ELISPOT, AMS and FACs. As Specific to Small Molecule: Hands-on experience with the development, validation and troubleshooting of the methods for LC/MS quantitation, along with experience implementing HPLC/UPLC/GC separation, sample preparation techniques, mass spectrometry detection platforms and their application in clinical sample analysis. Experience with human ADME, protein binding, immunocapturing hybrid assays and technologies such as LC-AMS and HRMS. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (BASED ON THE POSITION LEVEL AND REQUIRED EXPERIENCE) Demonstrated CRO management and outsourcing experience. Experience with regulatory inspections. Experience preparing regulatory submissions and addressing regulatory queries. Understanding of clinical trial design and overall principles of clinical development and related disciplines (e.g., pharmacokinetics and clinical pharmacology, statistics, ADME, formulation and drug product). Prior experience with training, mentoring or managing colleagues. QUALIFICATIONS / SKILLS EDUCATION PhD or equivalent in biology or analytical chemistry/chemistry. M.S. degrees will be considered based on relevant industry experience BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Minimum of 5-8 years of industry or bioanalytical experience with PK and/or immunogenicity assay and biomarker assay development, validation, and sample analyses using chromatographic/mass spectrometry, ligand binding (ELISA and ECL) or other methodologies like flow cytometry, FISH and etc. (as relevant to the role). Working knowledge of GxP regulations governing conduct of clinical trials and regulatory guidances and expectations relevant to regulated bioanalysis. Subject matter expert in regulated bioanalysis small organic molecules or Biologics and understanding of bioanalytical techniques commonly used for Biomarkers. In depth knowledge of GxP regulations governing conduct of clinical trials and regulatory guidances and expectations relevant to regulated bioanalysis. Demonstrated ability to think strategically, work in a highly matrixed environment, and execute multiple projects simultaneously. Highly effective communication skills: verbal, written, and presentation. #LI-PFE Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. Who We Are 
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
 What We Offer 
 Location:
Chengdu,CHN 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.  
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
 Use digital analytics for troubleshooting   
 Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
 Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
 Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
 Minimum Qualifications:   
 Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification
 1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
 Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
 Basic mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics
 Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols
 Preferred Qualifications:   
 2–4 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.   Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.
 Additional Information 
 Time Type: 
Full time 
 Employee Type: 
Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
Yes, 75% of the Time 
 Relocation Eligible: 
Yes 
 Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

1. Role Summary The Digital & Technology Head leads the China Commercial Excellence & Innovation Digital & Technology (D&T) organization – the "Scale & Run" engine of CEI. The role is accountable for China’s commercial data foundation, enterprise engineering and deployment, and the reliable operation of all China commercial systems, and for turning AI solutions validated by the AI Transformation Office (AITO) into secure, production-scale and adopted business capabilities. This leader oversees an integrated portfolio of three lines: Data Engineering & Semantics; Enterprise Engineering, Deployment & Operations; and Technology Adoption, Engagement & Transformation. D&T joins every AI product from MVP and owns production, scale and business-as-usual. The role connects China market priorities with global Digital & Technology direction and converts strategy into scalable capabilities, sustained adoption and measurable business value. 2. Key Accountabilities Define and execute the China CEI Digital & Technology strategy, target operating model and multi-year roadmap, aligned with China business priorities and global Digital & Technology direction. Lead technology-enabled business transformation by translating commercial ambition into redesigned processes, workflows, products, data capabilities, operating models and measurable value realization. Establish and enable high-performing CEI PODs with clear business outcomes, decision rights, product ownership, cross-functional staffing, architecture guardrails, delivery flow, adoption measures and exit or transition criteria. Extend China delivery capability through a deliberate partnership with PIC (Pfizer Innovation Center), combining CEI business context and Digital & Technology architecture, engineering and governance with PIC build capacity and China-to-global potential. Own technology portfolio choices and investment priorities across commercial systems, data capabilities, digital products and enterprise services, applying reuse-before-build and scale-or-stop discipline, in alignment with the AITO AI portfolio. Scale AI responsibly: take AITO-validated AI solutions from MVP to secure, compliant, reliable production and business-as-usual, with a BAU owner agreed before scale and one go-live gate for data, privacy and compliance readiness. Set enterprise architecture and engineering direction for commercial systems across solution composition, integration, DevSecOps, site reliability engineering, security, cost and technical observability, aligned with AITO reference architectures. Ensure enterprise data is AI-ready through data engineering, semantic standards, governance, quality, lineage and observability; deliver the CL layer of the AI Empowered Consumption Layer (AICL) as one POD with AITO (AI layer) and GCA Data Strategy & Management Team. Oversee reliable lifecycle operation of China commercial technology products and services, including modernization, operational readiness, releases, incidents, service performance and retirement decisions. Lead, develop and inspire the sub-function leads and their teams, strengthening leadership succession, technical depth, inclusive collaboration, transformation capability and outcome ownership. Build trusted partnerships with global Digital & Technology, Legal, Privacy, Risk, Compliance, Security, Procurement, strategic vendors and systems integrators. 3. Required Capabilities & Competencies (a) Critical Capabilities & Qualifications Digital and technology strategy; business and AI transformation; commercial operating-model design; executive stakeholder leadership; enterprise architecture; technology portfolio and investment management. Enterprise engineering and deployment; data strategy, semantics and governance; product lifecycle; POD and agile delivery models; operational excellence; vendor and ecosystem management; working knowledge of AI and LLM deployment and operations. Strong knowledge of cloud and data platforms, cybersecurity, privacy, digital risk, regulated-industry controls and the China technology ecosystem. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a closely related technical discipline. An MBA or equivalent business qualification is preferred. At least 20 years of progressive experience across technology, digital, data, analytics, AI and business transformation, including substantial senior leadership responsibility for complex enterprise capabilities. Demonstrated success leading enterprise-scale transformation and converting technology strategy into sustainable business outcomes, operating-model change and adoption. Proven leadership of diverse teams across data, engineering, architecture, operations, product, engagement or transformation disciplines. Strong executive communication and organizational influence across local, regional and global environments. Experience in a highly regulated industry and the China data, privacy, technology and vendor environment is preferred. (b) Leadership Expectations Transformation leadership: creates clarity from ambiguity and mobilizes business, technology and governance stakeholders around a shared future state. Business-first and outcome-led: connects technology choices to customer, colleague, operational and commercial outcomes. AI-first mindset: redesigns work around responsible human and AI collaboration rather than adding AI to existing processes. Enterprise perspective: balances China speed and relevance with global standards, reuse, interoperability and sustainability. Execution discipline: converts strategy into accountable roadmaps, investment choices, measurable benefits and reliable delivery. 4. Key Collaboration The leader works across Business Units and CEI capabilities — including Go-to-Market Transformation (GTMx), the AI Transformation Office (AITO), Global Commercial Analytics (GCA) and the Commercial Excellence (CE). It partners closely with AITO: D&T joins AI products from MVP and takes them to production, scale and BAU, and agrees the production boundary with AITO. It delivers AICL as one POD with AITO and GCA DSM, extends delivery capacity through partnership with the Pfizer Innovation Center (PIC), and establishes the conditions for cross-functional PODs to operate with speed and clear accountability. It also partners with International AIT leadership, China CEI leadership, global Digital & Technology, Legal, Privacy, Risk, Compliance, Security and Procurement, and strategic vendors and systems integrators. 5. Measures of Success Measurable business adoption, transformation outcomes and value realization from digital, data and AI capabilities. Effective POD operation, faster decisions and reliable progression from discovery and prototype to production, scale and business-as-usual ownership. Strong collaboration and shared accountability across Business Units, GTMx, GCA, CE, PIC and global Digital & Technology. Secure, compliant and resilient operation of commercial technology products and services. Improved data quality, semantic consistency, accessibility, observability and AI readiness, including timely delivery of the AICL CL layer. Greater reuse of enterprise platforms, patterns and data products, and clean MVP-to-scale handovers from AITO with a named BAU owner. A high-performing organization with stronger leadership depth, critical skills and succession readiness. Role Summary The PharmSci China Project Lead is responsible for coordination, alignment, and delivery of PharmSci/PGS related activities for China drug development programs. The role ensures alignment between global PSPT/CDT strategy and China clinical, regulatory, and commercial objectives, enabling efficient, compliant, and on time China development and registration. This position serves as the single point PharmSci integrator for assigned assets across development stages (CTA through NDA), working across global technical teams and China asset teams to drive execution and issue resolution. Key Responsibilities Portfolio & Project Leadership • Lead and coordinate PharmSci China activities for assigned small molecule, large molecule, or vaccine programs, ensuring delivery against China project milestones and timelines. • Align global PSPT/CDT strategies with China development needs and translate global plans into actionable China PharmSci execution plans. • Manage PharmSci deliverables across development phases, including CTA and NDA milestones. China–Global Strategy Alignment • Act as the primary PharmSci interface between global (PSTL/CDTL/PPL, global PharmSci, PGS, etc.) and China asset teams. • Collect China-specific inputs from local functions and propose China aligned development strategies to PSPT/CDT leadership. • Communicate global strategy decisions and updates back to China teams clearly and promptly. Regulatory & NDA Support • Lead preparation and execution of China NDA PharmSci strategies, including kickoff, planning, and execution. • Drive development and alignment of JX/JS importation specifications, working with global and China teams to address method gaps, agency feedback, etc. • Proactively identify risks related to testing readiness, sample availability, long lead time items, and regulatory expectations. Execution & Issue Management • Manage deliverables, timelines, and dependencies, ensuring early visibility of risks and mitigation plans. • Rapidly respond to changes in China regulatory requirements, clinical protocols, or commercial timelines, and support updates to PharmSci plans accordingly. • Support accelerated China development strategies (e.g., shortened trials, parallel activities) where applicable. Governance, Communication & Knowledge Sharing • Facilitate regular alignment meetings to drive execution and decision making across stakeholders. • Contribute to and leverage China development playbooks, whitepapers, and technical guidance to promote consistency and best practices. • Ensure accurate documentation, communication, and escalation of key PharmSci issues. Qualifications & Experience Education • Advanced degree (PhD, MS, or equivalent) in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline. Experience • Solid experience in pharmaceutical development, CMC, or PharmSci related project leadership. • Exposure to China drug development and registration pathways is highly desirable. • Proven ability to work effectively in highly matrixed, global teams., Skills & Competencies • Strong project and stakeholder management skills. • Ability to synthesize complex technical and regulatory topics into clear, executable plans. • Effective communicator across cultures and disciplines in Chinese and English. • High sense of ownership, accountability, and execution focus. • Comfortable operating in fast changing regulatory and development environments. Why This Role Matters The PharmSci China Project Lead is essential to delivering China projects on time, with quality and regulatory success, while minimizing rework and inefficiency. This role directly enables China’s contribution to global development programs and ensures China specific needs are integrated early and effectively. 1. Role Summary The Director owns the China AI platform and the China LLM foundation end to end – architecture, engineering, security and compliance, release management, roadmap and budget. The platform gives Pfizer China teams governed access to locally available large language models (for example Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM) on China cloud providers, with an AI gateway and guardrails, separate innovation and production environments, and model and agent tooling on top. Its users are business analysts, data scientists and engineers across Pfizer China Commercial. Self-hosting of open-weight models may be a future requirement. The role is the single AITO interface with Corporate and Global CIO teams on the AI platform, makes China requirements visible to Global, re-uses global patterns before local build to avoid fragmentation, and runs the AI platform release gate. This is a hands-on leadership role: in the first year, the Director stands up and runs the China cloud environments and AI platform while building the AI platform team. 2. Key Accountabilities Own the China AI platform end to end: architecture, engineering, security and compliance, release management, product roadmap and budget for licenses and infrastructure; maintain the roadmap with China business stakeholders and CIO platform teams, and decide which global platform capabilities are localized and which need a China-built equivalent. Own cloud platform engineering on China cloud providers (Tencent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS China): environments, identity and access management, GPU capacity, model serving and deployment, monitoring, automation and infrastructure as code. Own and manage the China LLM foundation: model selection, qualification, evaluation, version and lifecycle management, providing the model and platform layer on which the AI layer of the AI Empowered Consumption Layer (AICL) and China AI solutions are built; plan for self-hosting of open-weight models as a future option. Lead onboarding and qualification of new models, cloud services and tools – security, privacy (including China data residency under PIPL), legal and China generative AI compliance – following global guidelines, and keep the platform inventory current. Set AI platform and engineering standards: reference architectures, reusable patterns and non-functional requirements for model integration, agent runtime, guardrails, evaluation and MLOps / LLMOps, and engineering practices (code review, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, documentation). Act as the single AITO interface with Corporate and Global CIO teams on the AI platform and its cloud, security and architecture requirements; represent China in global platform roadmaps, re-use global patterns (gateway, guardrails, observability, agent frameworks) where they apply, and bring China-proven capabilities back for global reuse. Run the AI platform release gate that controls which models, services and AI components move from the innovation environment to production, aligned with the D&T go-live gate for business solutions. Run the AI platform as a service: in-region on-call and incident response with escalation to global teams, runbooks, and reporting of service health, model and token utilization and cost into Pfizer’s global AI dashboards. Work with Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Cybersecurity and the China Data Protection Office (DPO) so the platform operates within guardrails, and manage cloud and software license vendors. Support builder adoption with China business teams and engineers through sample agents, reusable components, documentation, training and an active user community, in step with GTMx AI fluency and enablement programs. Lead and develop the AI platform team of colleagues and contractors, plus matrixed PIC capacity: set engineering standards (code review, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, documentation), hold the team to them, mentor engineers and stay hands-on to fill gaps. 3. Required Capabilities & Competencies (a) Critical Capabilities & Qualifications AI platform engineering and technical product leadership, with production experience of model serving or Model as a Service (MaaS) integration, an AI gateway, guardrails or content moderation, and at least one agent framework. Cloud platform engineering on at least one major cloud (Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud or AWS): containers and Kubernetes, identity and access management, GPU capacity, infrastructure as code and CI/CD; writes production-quality Python and is comfortable with Linux and Git. LLM foundation management: model selection, pre-production evaluation (safety, content compliance and performance) and lifecycle management. Has run a production service to service level agreements (SLAs): monitoring and observability, on-call, incident management and cloud cost control. Has taken new technology through enterprise security, privacy and architecture review before production use. Proven partnership with Corporate or Global CIO organizations, and experience managing technology suppliers, including cloud hosting and software license agreements. Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence or a closely related discipline. Typically 12+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years hands-on building and running production cloud, data or AI platforms and experience hiring, leading and developing engineers, including contractors. Candidates with an exceptional background may be considered from 10+ years. Professional working proficiency in Mandarin and English. Preferred: working knowledge of the Personal Information Protection Law (PIPL), the Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC) rules for generative AI services and the Multi-Level Protection Scheme (MLPS); experience serving open-weight models on GPU infrastructure (domestic accelerators a plus); enterprise single sign-on (SAML/OIDC) and cloud IAM integration; experience in a multinational working with global platform, security and governance teams across time zones; pharmaceutical or other regulated industry experience. (b) Leadership Expectations Outcome ownership: connects platform decisions to measurable business, user, service and transformation outcomes. AI-first and enterprise-minded: applies responsible AI, reuse, architecture, security, privacy and scale principles appropriate to the work. POD collaboration: enables clear accountability, effective cross-functional execution and minimal handoff friction across peer teams and partners. Precision and learning: communicates technical decisions and trade-offs clearly to senior business and technology leaders, uses evidence and telemetry and continuously improves the service. Hands-on and resilient: stays close to the engineering, keeps digging into hard technical problems until the root cause is understood, and grows platform engineering talent. 4. Key Collaboration The Director works within AITO under the AITO Head and partners closely with the AIT Acceleration Lead, whose engineering team builds AI solutions, small language models and the AICL AI layer on the platform. The role works with D&T Data Engineering & Semantics, which owns the AICL data (CL) layer, and with GCA DSM, which owns AICL business definitions and unified KPIs, delivering AICL as one POD. It agrees the production boundary with D&T Enterprise Engineering, Deployment & Operations, which runs the business applications built on the platform, aligns the AI platform release gate with the D&T go-live gate, and directs matrixed PIC and contractor capacity. Externally to CEI, the role is the primary AITO interface with Corporate and Global CIO platform, cloud hosting, cybersecurity and AI governance teams, and works with Procurement, Legal, Compliance, the China Data Protection Office (DPO) and technology vendors including Alibaba Cloud and Tencent Cloud. 5. Measures of Success A secure, compliant and cost-transparent China AI platform and LLM foundation, running to agreed service levels. Every new model, service and tool onboarded through a documented qualification and AI platform release gate. Clear alignment with Corporate and Global CIO standards: global patterns re-used, China requirements on the global roadmap, and no fragmented local platforms. Clear localize-versus-build decisions, with China-proven capabilities contributed back for global reuse.
