1. Role Summary The AI Transformation Office Head owns Pfizer China’s AI transformation agenda and brings China’s AI capability into one lean, flat office. The role aligns AI strategy, portfolio, value and adoption with commercial priorities, owns the China AI platform and LLM foundation, and leads rapid AI build through a dedicated AI engineering pool. The AITO Head decides what AI is worth doing, proves value quickly in PO-led PODs, and hands proven solutions to Digital & Technology (D&T) to scale and run. 2. Key Accountabilities AI Strategy & Portfolio Land China’s AI strategy and ensure alignment with International AIT priorities and enterprise standards. Own the AI portfolio: intake, prioritization, funding gates, and scale / stop decisions, maintained in a single, prioritized backlog against clear value criteria. Value & Investment Own the business case, KPIs and benefits realization for AI investments, including model-cost economics, supported by the AIT Value & Performance Lead and the AIT Portfolio PMO. Co-own, with GTMx, the build / buy / partner recommendation and ecosystem judgement for AI solutions. AI Product & Rapid Build Lead the AI Product Owners directly; run each AI product as a PO-led POD with a single business outcome owner, one PO from MVP to scale, D&T engaged from MVP, and a BAU owner agreed before scale. Lead, through the AIT Acceleration Lead (Principal Engineer), the AI engineering pool and Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) for rapid prototyping, solution build, small language models and the AICL AI layer, flexing with matrixed PIC and contractor capacity. AI Platform & Foundation Own, through the AI Platform & Foundation Director, the China AI platform and China LLM foundation — architecture, cloud engineering, model onboarding and qualification, and the production release gate — as the single AITO interface with Corporate and Global CIO teams. Make localize-versus-build decisions for global platform capabilities, re-use global patterns before local build, and bring China-proven capabilities back for global reuse. Own AI layer of the AI Empowered Consumption Layer (AICL) and ensure it is delivered as one POD. Adoption & China-for-Global Partner with GTMx, which leads AI fluency, champions, change and adoption, so that validated AI products land in the business; support builder adoption of the China AI platform. Grow the China-for-Global reusable AI offering — turn China-proven solutions into reusable assets, make the value case for global reuse, and drive adopt / adapt / decline decisions with International AIT. 3. Required Capabilities & Competencies (a) Technical Competency & Experience AI-native leadership with hands-on fluency and technical depth — able to credibly challenge feasibility, model choice, cost and reuse. Deep experience with LLMs and agentic AI: prompt / RAG, agent workflows, evaluation, guardrails, and enterprise-grade deployment. Working knowledge of AI platform and cloud architecture on China cloud providers, LLM foundation and MLOps / LLMOps, and China generative AI compliance (PIPL, CAC rules), sufficient to govern platform choices with Corporate and Global CIO teams. AI portfolio and value management, including model-cost / cost-per-outcome discipline. Product management and rapid experimentation at scale — leading product owners and engineering teams to move ideas from concept to validated MVP. Experience deploying AI in real commercial scenarios, ideally including China ecosystem contexts (e.g. WeChat / enterprise assistants, local model options). Able to bring large-scale technology / internet-industry AI innovation experience into a commercial pharma organization. 12+ years in AI / digital, with 5+ years leading AI or advanced-analytics teams; proven delivery of AI products into real business use. jobs.job_description_raw: 1. Role Summary The Director, AIT Acceleration Lead runs Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) and AI engineering as one acceleration engine, working with AI Product Owners to move high-value ideas from opportunity framing to validated minimum viable products. The role turns prioritized AI demand into working, evaluated solutions at speed, then hands them to Digital & Technology (D&T) and PIC for production, scale and sustainable ownership. The Acceleration Lead owns the rapid-validation and AI engineering capability within AITO, setting engineering and validation standards and leading a multidisciplinary engineering squad that works in PO-led PODs to prove feasibility, desirability and value before scale decisions. The FDE squad focuses on 0→1 business validation of flagship AI opportunities, rapid solution build, small language model development and the AI layer of the AI Empowered Consumption Layer (AICL). 2. Key Accountabilities Lead FDE and AI engineering as a single acceleration engine, moving prioritized AI portfolio ideas from opportunity framing through rapid prototype, proof of concept and validated MVP. Partner with AI Product Owners, who report to the AITO Head, on product vision, scope, backlog and MVP success criteria; own technical feasibility, solution build, evaluation evidence and scale-readiness for the prioritized AI portfolio. Work with AI Product Owners in PO-led PODs, providing FDE and engineering capacity per product and applying shared discovery, engineering and validation standards. Lead the AIT FDE squad for fast, hands-on solution design, prototyping and validation of flagship AI opportunities (0→1). Lead rapid AI solution development and implementation through the AI engineering team: agentic applications, RAG pipelines and system integrations built on the China AI platform, using its reference architectures and guardrails. Own small language model (SLM) and domain model development for priority commercial use cases – data preparation, fine-tuning, distillation and evaluation of open-weight models – deployed through the China LLM foundation and production release gate owned by the AI Platform & Foundation Director. Own the AI layer of AICL (agents, retrieval and orchestration), delivered as one POD with the D&T Data line (CL layer) and GCA DSM (business definitions and unified KPIs). Drive builder adoption with China business teams and engineers through sample agents, reusable components, documentation, training and an active user community, in step with GTMx AI fluency and enablement programs. Apply disciplined validation gates - feasibility, desirability and value - so only evidenced solutions progress to scale. Manage the acceleration-to-scale seam with D&T and PIC, ensuring validated solutions have clear ownership, production architecture, evaluation evidence, funding and transition plans. Partner with the AIT Value & Performance Lead to connect product decisions to business cases, KPIs and model-cost economics. Lead and develop a multidisciplinary engineering squad, balancing speed, quality and reuse. 3. Required Capabilities & Competencies (a) Critical Capabilities & Qualifications Strong AI product sense and proven partnership with product owners: discovery-to-MVP practices, value-based prioritization and translating business problems into technical solutions. Forward deployment / applied AI engineering: agentic applications, retrieval, model and API integration, orchestration, prompt and context engineering, evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design. Hands-on experience building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines – embeddings, re-rankers and vector databases – and writing production-quality Python. Small language model and domain model development: fine-tuning, distillation and evaluation of open-weight models on GPU infrastructure, including sizing and performance testing; experience on domestic accelerators is a plus. Rapid experimentation and validation at scale — moving ideas from concept to evaluated MVP with clear evidence. Working knowledge of MLOps and LLMOps, model-cost / cost-per-outcome discipline and enterprise deployment seams. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering or a closely related discipline; an advanced technical or business degree is preferred. Typically 1 2 + years of progressive relevant experience, including several years leading AI engineering and applied AI teams at scope and complexity appropriate to the Director level. Candidates with an exceptional background may be considered from 10+ years. Demonstrated ability to work across business, product, technology, data and governance stakeholders in a matrixed environment. Experience in a highly regulated industry and the China technology, data, privacy or vendor environment is preferred. (b) Leadership Expectations Outcome ownership: connects decisions to measurable business, user, service and transformation outcomes. AI-first and enterprise-minded: applies responsible AI, reuse, architecture, security, privacy and scale principles appropriate to the work. POD collaboration: enables clear accountability, effective cross-functional execution and minimal handoff friction across peer teams and partners. Precision and learning: communicate clearly, documents decisions, uses evidence and telemetry and continuously improves delivery. Acceleration mindset: drives speed with rigor, making timely scale or stop calls on the evidence. 4. Key Collaboration The Director partners with the AI Product Owners on product backlog and MVP scope, and with the AIT Value & Performance Lead on business cases and investment decisions and works within AITO under the AITO Head. The role builds on the China AI platform and LLM foundation owned by the AI Platform & Foundation Director, and delivers the AICL AI layer as one POD with D&T Data Engineering & Semantics (CL layer) and GCA DSM (business definitions and unified KPIs). It manages the acceleration-to-scale seam with Digital & Technology (D&T) and the Pfizer Innovation Center (PIC), directs matrixed PIC and contractor capacity, and partners with Go-to-Market Transformation (GTMx), Global Commercial Analytics (GCA) and China Business Units to shape demand and land solutions. It also works with International AIT product and engineering communities, and with Legal, Privacy, Risk, Compliance and Security stakeholders. 5. Measures of Success High-value ideas progressed from opportunity framing to validated, evaluated MVP with a named owner and clear scale or stop decision. Faster, higher-quality validation and a clean acceleration-to-scale transition to D&T and PIC. Strong engineering and validation discipline – clear standards and evaluation coverage, with close alignment with AI Product Owners on backlog and MVP criteria. Reuse of AI products and FDE patterns across the prioritized portfolio. AICL AI layer and priority small language models delivered on the China AI platform, with evaluation evidence and reuse across use cases. Job Purpose and Impact 
 The Senior Analyst, Commercial Capability Deployment plays a critical role in deploying and scaling commercial pricing capabilities across global businesses. The position is expected to act as a Thought partner and Vision champion. This role serves as the bridge between commercial teams, local business stakeholders, and digital product teams to ensure successful implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement of pricing and costing solutions. 
The role is responsible for business readiness, deployment execution, process standardization, user adoption, and operational governance. The successful candidate combines commercial acumen, analytical problem-solving, technology understanding, and strong stakeholder management to deliver sustainable business value and support global pricing transformation initiatives. 
 Key Accountabilities 
 Lead Commercial Capability Deployments 
•    Lead deployment of global pricing and commercial products costing capabilities across regions and businesses. 
•    Partner with local stakeholders to assess current-state costing and pricing processes and align them with global operating models and templates. 
•    Conduct business readiness activities, including process discovery, gap assessment, stakeholder alignment, master data readiness, and deployment planning. 
•    Coordinate configuration, testing, training, cutover, parallel-run validation, and stabilization activities. 
•    Develop and apply reusable deployment playbooks, templates, and standards to shorten implementation cycles. 
•    Manage deployment risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, decisions, and stakeholder alignment. 
 Drive Pricing and Costing Excellence 
•    Support the implementation and ongoing execution of price build, commercial products costing, etc 
•    Translate pricing and costing logic into scalable, system-enabled business processes. 
•    Coordinate process and data flows across PriceFX, SAP, formulation systems, and other connected platforms. 
•    Ensure workflows support business governance, validation, variation checks, and exception management. 
•    Monitor process effectiveness, data quality, cost-reject trends, and pricing-condition errors, and coordinate resolution of systemic issues. 
•    Drive alignment with the global pricing model while identifying opportunities for automation and continuous improvement. 
 Support Commercial Product Ownership 
•    Represent operational pricing and commercial execution needs in solution design and enhancement discussions. 
•    Partner with product owners and technical teams to capture requirements, refine user stories, define acceptance criteria, and support minimum viable product scoping. 
•    Evaluate enhancement requests for strategic fit, reuse potential, business value, and alignment with global templates. 
•    Contribute to roadmap planning, backlog prioritization, testing, release readiness, and production deployment. 
•    Validate business outcomes and monitor adoption and value realization after deployment. 
•    Aggregate regional feedback and recurring pain points and communicate them to global commercial excellence and digital product teams. 
 Drive Adoption, Change Management, and Capability Building   
•    Lead change management and user-readiness activities for commercial capability implementations. 
•    Develop and maintain training materials, process documentation, deployment guidance, and user enablement resources. 
•    Facilitate workshops and stakeholder engagement activities that build understanding, ownership, and commitment. 
•    Support local product owners and users during transition, hypercare, and ongoing operations. 
•    Promote best-practice sharing and ongoing learning across regions and businesses. 
•    Establish measures for adoption, compliance, process health, and value realization. 
 Strengthen Governance and Continuous Improvement   
•    Promote adherence to global pricing standards, processes, governance frameworks, and the agreed solution template. 
•    Champion standardization and reuse of existing capabilities over unnecessary custom development. 
•    Support governance of master data, workflows, business rules, enriching values, roles, access, and operating procedures. 
•    Coordinate regional business calendars and clarify ownership of business inputs, validations, and exception handling. 
•    Leverage performance reporting and user feedback to identify and prioritize improvement opportunities. 
•    Communicate best practices across teams and support consistent execution across regions.
 Qualifications 
 Minimum Qualifications •    Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. 
•    Experience in pricing, commercial operations, product costing, business transformation, process improvement, or commercial excellence. 
•    Experience leading or supporting implementation of business systems and digital capabilities. 
•    Strong analytical, systems-thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complex processes and identify key decision variables. 
•    Experience with process mapping, process documentation, testing, training, and change management. 
•    Demonstrated ability to work across commercial, pricing, finance, supply chain, and technical product teams. 
•    Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and cross-functional leadership capabilities. 
•    Ability to translate business needs into clear requirements and explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 
•    Professional proficiency in English. 
 Preferred Qualifications •    Experience with PriceFX or a comparable pricing platform. 
•    Knowledge of price build, commercial products costing, bill-of-material structures, margin management, and pricing governance. 
•    Understanding of SAP master data, product costing, BOM structures, pricing conditions, and commercial system integrations. 
•    Familiarity with formulation systems, Salesforce, business intelligence tools, or related commercial platforms. 
•    Experience working in Agile product delivery environments and supporting product backlogs and enhancement governance. 
•    Experience supporting commercial, finance, supply chain, pricing, or revenue management organizations. 
•    Additional language capabilities relevant to the supported region.

As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.  
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment

 Minimum Qualifications:

 Willing to learn and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
 Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols.
 Preferred Qualifications:   
 1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Associate degree in electronics or engineering technologies
 Knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics
 Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

jobs.job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递/沟通/反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 1. 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 2. 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 3. 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 4. 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 5. 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 6. 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 7. 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会。 8. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 • 教育： - 具有医学、药学或相关专业大学专科及以上学历。 • 技能： - 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 - 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 • 经验： - 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 • 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 • 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等要求。 核心能力 专业合规: 坚持专业推广-掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规-工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断: 把握市场动态-随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息-合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动: 提供专业支持-积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作-对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行: 高效准确执行-及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务-对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 自我发展: 主动提升能力-把握内外部各种学习机会和资源，不断提升自身的能力和适应力。 创新变革: 积极拥抱变化-用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. Who We Are 
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. 
 What We Offer 
 Location:
Dalian,CHN 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Assists in planning the daily work schedule within assigned territory to ensure completion of Preventive Maintenance and remedial maintenance.
 Uses escalation policies as required to keep management informed of down situations.
 Verifies and approves the operational quality of system equipment. Performs daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, biannual, and annual periodic maintenance on systems within established time frames. Also performs wet cleans as required. Instructs customers in the operation and maintenance of systems. Troubleshoots and corrects process variations on systems partially with assistance from senior engineers.
 Assumes responsibility for complete customer satisfaction within assigned accounts. Assists in planning, communicating, and co-ordinating support plans with customer management.
 Performs start-up, warranty, paid service, and service contract activities. Performs TIER II start-ups within established time frames. Assists on TIER III start-ups. Provides technical assistance to less experienced Applied personnel. Uses training and experience to identify some process related system problems.
 Serves as the Company liaison with the customer's front line management on administrative and technical matters for assigned projects. Assists in the preparation of and participates in customer meetings.
 Develops and implements plans to increase productivity. Tracks equipment performance and plan uptime improvement. Has a working knowledge of Statistical Process Control. Utilises Quality Improvement Process methods and terminology.
 Plans and executes support activities on a wide range of Applied Materials' systems. May need technical assistance in performance of daily responsibilities.
 Other Requirements : This is a physically demanding position that often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.
 Functional Knowledge 
 Has developed proficiency in a range of analytical processes or procedures to carry out assigned tasks 
 Business Expertise 
 Has a good understanding of how the team integrates with others to achieve objectives
 Leadership 
 May provide informal guidance and support to more junior team members
 Problem Solving 
 Provides solutions to problems in situations that are atypical or infrequently occurring based on existing precedents or procedures
 Impact 
 Impacts the quality of own work and its contribution to the team
 Interpersonal Skills 
 Uses communication skills to regularly exchange information 
 Additional Information 
 Time Type: 
Full time 
 Employee Type: 
Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
Yes, 20% of the Time 
 Relocation Eligible: 
Yes 
 Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.  
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Install, maintain, and upgrade customer equipment
 Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with assistance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] and/or the customer to understand roadmaps, process flows, inflection points, requirements, and business challenges   
 Train and mentor junior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems
 Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
 Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
 Minimum Qualifications:   
 Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification
 4-7 years of work experience in semiconductor industry or other equipment support industry
 Advanced mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, and/or thermodynamics
 Strong knowledge of hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.   Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems.  Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment

 Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]

 1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics

Strategic and Special Tax Projects · Lead or support strategic projects involving tax optimization, process transformation, risk mitigation and cross-functional implementation. · Develop project plans, perform technical and financial analysis, coordinate stakeholders, track actions and drive delivery. · Support significant VAT optimization initiatives, including sustainable processes, controls, documentation and defense of tax positions. · Use technology, automation and AI-enabled tools to improve tax processes and analytical capabilities. · Coordinate internal stakeholders and external advisors to convert technical recommendations into practical implementation plans. 4.  Applied Materials is seeking a Senior Procurement Manager to support its Photonics Platform Business, which drives both organic and inorganic growth of the company’s waveguide technologies and broader augmented reality (AR) ecosystem initiatives. This strategic role focuses on sourcing, qualification, supplier development, and quality management for advanced optical materials, including precision glass and crystalline substrates.
 The Senior Procurement Manager will collaborate closely with global suppliers and cross‑functional teams across R&D, Product Engineering, and Operations. The ideal candidate has deep hands‑on experience with optical glass and crystalline materials, strong knowledge of upstream manufacturing processes, and a proven ability to build and manage a high‑performance supply base. This individual will lead supplier assessments, define category strategies, and implement quality frameworks that ensure supply chain scalability, reliability, and long‑term competitiveness for Applied Materials’ photonics portfolio. The role will also be accountable for achieving key procurement KPIs across cost, cash, and contract performance to support the company’s growth and profitability objectives.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1) Supplier Lifecycle Management & Performance 
 Conduct supplier assessments, audits, and qualifications for glass and crystalline materials to ensure compliance with Applied Materials standards and regulatory requirements.
 Develop, manage, and utilize supplier scorecards and performance metrics, driving corrective actions and continuous improvement.
 Lead structured Business Reviews and executive-level engagement to strengthen relationships, track performance, and ensure roadmap alignment.
 Institutionalize standardized supplier governance frameworks, including supplier segmentation, financial health reviews and performance management for alliance and strategic suppliers.
 2) Quality Engineering, Compliance & Continuous Improvement 
 Develop and support APQP, PPAP, SPC, control plans, and material-specific quality systems for waveguide and AR-related components.
 Drive root cause analysis and CAPA/SCAR resolution using 8D, and FMEA, ensuring containment and systemic prevention.
 Partner with R&D and Manufacturing teams to improve material yields, durability, metrology consistency, and upstream manufacturing capability.
 Support implementation of supplier quality maturity models that scale with NPI and high-volume manufacturing requirements.
 3) Strategic Sourcing, Category Leadership & Commercial Management 
 Establish and lead a Specialized Procurement & Supplier Strategy function, enabling the business to achieve top‑quartile cost performance, cash optimization, and operational expense control.
 Develop and execute category strategies for optical glass, crystalline substrates, coatings, and enabling materials, embedding these strategies into the NPI lifecycle to accelerate speed‑to‑market.
 Lead sourcing events (RFx), supplier selection, and TCO analysis, including should‑cost modeling and competitive benchmarking.
 Deliver procurement KPIs across cost, cash, and contracts, including cost reduction, competitive pricing, payment term optimization, and contract compliance.
 Negotiate MSAs, SOWs, NDAs, and commercial frameworks that secure supply assurance, protect IP, and provide long‑term competitive advantage.
 4) Supplier Development, Innovation & Technology Enablement 
 Develop suppliers to meet scaling, capability, and technical maturity requirements through structured development plans and capability assessments.
 Foster supplier innovation, aligning emerging materials technologies (glass, crystalline, coatings, surface treatments) to Applied Materials’ waveguide and AR/VR product roadmaps.
 Support NPI by qualifying new and alternate suppliers, validating materials, and ensuring readiness from prototype → pilot → ramp → volume.
 5) Supply Chain Risk Management & AR Market Growth Support 
 Assess supply chain risks across quality, cost, delivery, capacity, and geopolitical exposure; implement mitigation plans and dual‑sourcing strategies.
 Lead supplier integration and quality due diligence activities for acquisitions, strategic partnerships, or emerging suppliers.
 Collaborate with R&D, Product Engineering, Sourcing, and Operations to align specifications, resolve escalations, and scale next‑generation photonics technologies in support of AR market growth.

jobs.job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通地区经理负责管理所辖区域的一切业务，包括制订和实施区域的工作目标和发展计划，建立一个绩效良好、极富生产力和士气高昂的团队。对客户的需求做出适当反应以实现区域的各项工作目标。对医学信息沟通专员的行为进行规范和监管，对他们的专业技能提升和学习发展规划提供辅导和支持。 主要工作和任务 1. 制订并执行所辖区域的业务计划，推动团队实现公司和上级经理下达的各项工作目标和任务。 2. 招聘符合公司基本要求的人员（包括各种雇佣形式和编制），定期对团队成员进行绩效和行为的评估，实施奖惩或激励措施。 3. 制订并执行培养团队成员合规意识的计划，规范其工作行为，确保各项活动的真实性和合规性。 4. 制订并执行提升团队成员的专业知识和技能的计划，并对其个人发展规划提供指导与支持。 5. 通过有计划的随访，在与专员讨论区域业务及市场活动时对其进行针对性的辅导。 6. 监控和分析市场发展趋势，挖掘区域市场机会，为公司策略的制订提供反馈和建议。 7. 协调并有效地实施各个项目及活动，合理分配和控制各项资源。有效管理项目和活动的流程，确保其真实有效地开展。 8. 与区域内关键客户保持持续的沟通，建立并持续优化合作伙伴关系。 9. 熟悉对当前及未来业务有影响的政策，必要情况下可根据公司的要求，与相关职能部门合作，参与或协调所辖区域的市场准入工作。 10. 建立和保持有效沟通系统，包括定期召开地区会议，定期与上级经理汇报区域工作进展，与其他部门建立协作关系。 11. 为制订和修改业务相关的政策和流程及其他内部政策提供建议，以实现高效率的业务运作。 12. 支持公司的各项创新举措，带领团队成员执行新举措，并且主动探索创新的机会和方法。 13. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 · 教育： - 具有《医药代表管理办法》（包括不时的修订）要求的医学、药学或相关专业大学专科及以上学历。 · 技能： - 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 - 具备较好的相关产品领域的专业知识。 - 具备较强的影响力和策略性思维能力。 - 具备较强的沟通，计划，组织和问题解决能力。 - 具备较强的团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 · 经验： - 至少 3 年制药行业同等公司的医药代表工作经验，具备符合合规要求的优秀的绩效记录, 具备管理潜力。 - 有制药行业业务管理经验者优先。 · 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers . Sales

Who We Are 
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. 
 What We Offer 
 Location:
Hefei,CHN 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
 Use digital analytics for troubleshooting   
 Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
 Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
 Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
 Minimum Qualifications:   
 Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification
 1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
 Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
 Basic mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics
 Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols
 Preferred Qualifications:   
 2–4 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.   Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.
 Additional Information 
 Time Type: 
Full time 
 Employee Type: 
Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
Yes, 20% of the Time 
 Relocation Eligible: 
Yes 
 Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

This role requires a deep understanding of social media dynamics, content generation for KOLs/KOCs, and compliance with pharmaceutical regulations. The ideal candidate will combine creativity with analytical rigor to drive engagement while ensuring brand integrity and adherence to industry guidelines. 核心职责 Key Responsibilities 1. 社交媒体策略与执行 1. Social Media Strategy & Execution 制定并实施基于数据的社交媒体策略，针对处方药受众（患者/HCPs）覆盖多平台（如抖音、小红书、微博、微信、专业医疗论坛）。 主导KOL/KOC合作：识别、签约并管理与医疗领域影响者的合作，共同创作合规、教育性强且具有吸引力的内容。 监督内容/话题策划，确保符合医学、法律和合规（MLR）审核流程。 基于对各平台逻辑、算法、优缺点的理解，优化平台专属运营策略（如短视频 vs. 长图文）。 Develop and implement data-driven social media strategies tailored to prescription drug audiences (patients/HCPs) across platforms (e.g., Douyin, Rednote, Weibo, WeChat, and professional forums). Lead KOL/KOC collaboration: Identify, onboard, and manage partnerships with healthcare influencers to co-create compliant, educational, and engaging content. Oversee content/topic generation, ensuring alignment with medical, legal, and regulatory (MLR) review processes. Optimize platform-specific approaches by leveraging knowledge of each platform’s logic, algorithms, advantages, and limitations (e.g., short-video vs. long-form content). 2. 合规与商业敏锐度 2. Compliance & Business Acumen 严格遵守医药广告法规（如中国《药品管理法》、临床指南），确保所有内容合规。严格遵守公司的相关规定，确保零合规事件。 将复杂的医学信息转化为易懂、患者友好的内容，同时保证准确性。 监测行业趋势和竞品动态，识别机会与风险。 Navigate strict pharmaceutical advertising regulations (e.g., China’s Drug Administration Law, clinical guidelines) to ensure all content meets compliance standards. Strictly adhere to company regulations to ensure zero compliance incidents. Translate complex medical information into accessible, patient-friendly content without compromising accuracy. Monitor industry trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities and risks. 3. 绩效管理与责任感 3. Performance & Accountability 设定KPI（触达、浏览、互动等）并定期分析数据以优化策略。 跨团队协作（医学事务、合规法务、企业沟通、BU等），确保社交媒体目标与业务目标一致。 快速应对危机或错误信息。 Define KPIs (Reach, view, interaction, etc.) and regularly analyze performance to refine strategies. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Medical Affairs, Compliance & Legal, Communication, etc.) to align social media efforts with business goals. Manage crises or misinformation swiftly. 4. 创新与适应力 4. Innovation & Adaptability 尝试新兴形式（如医生直播问答、互动工具）以提升用户参与。 根据平台更新、法规变化或用户行为调整策略。 Experiment with emerging formats (e.g., live Q&A with HCPs, interactive tools) to enhance user engagement. Adapt strategies based on platform updates, regulatory changes, or shifts in patient/HCP behavior. 任职要求 Qualifications 经验: 3年以上社交媒体运营经验，医药/医疗行业或强监管领域优先。 具备KOL/KOC管理及医疗健康内容创作经验。 熟悉处方药商业模式（如电商、互联网医院等）。 技能: 精通国内外社交媒体生态（如微信、抖音等）。 较强的商业意识，能平衡教育目标与商业需求。 熟练使用分析工具及合规流程。 品质: 责任心强、注重细节、恪守合规与职业道德。 适应快节奏和不确定性，主动性强。 Experience: 3+ years in social media operations, preferably in healthcare/pharmaceuticals or highly regulated industries. Who We Are 
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
 What We Offer 
 Location:
Chengdu,CHN, Hefei,CHN 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
As a Process Support Engineer (PSE), you'll play a critical role in guiding products through their entire lifecycle, from initial concept to final qualification. You will provide high-visibility customer support through on-site installations, system diagnoses, and the service and repair of complex systems and equipment. PSEs work closely with customers and R&D teams to develop leading-edge processes used to manufacture advanced semiconductor chips, and create hypothesis experiments and design of experiments (DOEs). You'll analyze data with statistics and compile reports with high-level conclusions on technically challenging process engineering experiments. Additionally, you will troubleshoot complex problems, perform root cause analyses, and resolve difficult process engineering and customer product issues. Process Support Engineers work across technologies such as: Chemical Vapor Deposition, Atomic Layer Deposition, Plasma Reactive Ion Etch, Physical Vapor Deposition, Anneal and Implant.  
 Role Responsibilities:  
 Provide high-visibility customer support through on-site installations, system diagnoses, and the service and repair of complex systems and equipment 
 Work closely with the customer to develop leading-edge processes used to manufacture the most advanced semiconductor chips, many of which are inside everyday electronic devices 
 Create hypothesis experiments and design of experiments (DOE); analyze data with statistics; and compile reports with high-level conclusions on technically challenging process engineering experiments 
 Troubleshoot complex problems; perform multiple root cause analysis; and resolve a variety of difficult process engineering and customer product issues  
 Communicate with both internal stakeholders and the customer to achieve goals with a focus on building relationships and establishing trust 
 Apply your growing knowledge of best practices to offer a new perspective using existing solutions  
 Serve as a resource for junior colleagues and a liaison between the customer and business unit; you may also lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in chemistry/ physics, materials engineering, electrical engineering, optoelectronics or related field 
 4–7 years of experience in the semiconductor fab or equipment industry  
 Strong interpersonal and communication skills to explain sensitive information and work to build consensus among project stakeholders 
 Communication proficiency in English language
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Master’s degree in a related field  
 Master's degree or above in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Semiconductor Engineering, or related fields.
 Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in ALD process development, optimization, or manufacturing support. 
 Strong understanding of thin film deposition fundamentals and ALD reaction mechanisms.
 Experience with process characterization tools such as XRR, Ellipsometry, SEM, TEM, XPS, FTIR, or related metrology techniques.
 Experience in DOE, SPC, and statistical data analysis.
 Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills.
 Good communication and teamwork abilities.
 Ability to travel domestically as required.
 Additional Information 
 Time Type: 
Full time 
 Employee Type: 
Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
Yes, 75% of the Time 
 Relocation Eligible: 
Yes

jobs.job_description_raw: Role Summary: The Development China Clinician is responsible for high quality and timely delivery of one or more interventional clinical trials for R&D. They apply technical excellence in the design of cost-efficient clinical trials to meet the needs of internal and external customers, ensure effective conduct and medical/scientific oversight of studies (in partnership with CTM) and support appropriate interpretation and communication of clinical trial data (including high quality regulatory submissions and product defense activities). They ensure compliance with internal and external standards, proactively mitigate risk and manage emerging clinical issues. The China Clinician may act as a site liaison and point of contact to expedite study start-up and conduct and to support clinical training, compliance and overall study quality. Responsibilities: Clinical Trials Co-chairs clinical study team and works collaboratively with other study team members. Point of accountability to the BU for design, conduct, interpretation and reporting of one or more clinical studies (or elements of those studies). Provides clinical and scientific expertise to the clinical trial strategy and protocol development process, including acquisition of knowledge of competitor products. Through application of Enhanced Clinical Trial Design (ECTD)/ Enhanced Quantitative Drug Development (EQDD), ensures the most efficient clinical protocols are developed. Designs/writes clinical trial outlines, protocols and amendments, in collaboration with internal contributors (e.g. statisticians, Outcomes Research(OR) specialists, clinical pharmacologists, clinical project managers, Regional Clinical Site Leads (RCSLs), market access colleagues, commercial development colleagues), internal experts (e.g. clinical program lead, global clinical lead, global clinical strategy lead), and external experts (e.g. investigators, key opinion leaders, advisory board members); ensures design is consistent with objectives. Proactive in authoring efficient protocols that minimize the likelihood of amendments. Identifies and assesses study risks to good clinical practices, subject rights/safety and data integrity throughout protocol development and study conduct; creates, implements and assesses effectiveness of mitigation plans. Provides clinical input to Study Team for monitoring guidelines, iq RAMP, statistical analysis plans, informed consent documents, clinical review forms, data edit checks, data quality planning, Regional Medical Monitor - Medical Oversight Plan as needed (ultimately oversees work of Study Team). Contributes to CRO / vendor selection to ensure study is conducted consistent with protocol requirements, clinical plan expectations, and study timelines; this includes ensuring medical/technical requirements for data integrity are applied (e.g. lab specifications). Approves selection of countries, clinical sites and investigators with appropriate qualifications, patient populations, and recruitment strategy to meet goals in a timely, high quality and cost effective manner. Ensures study is registered on www.ClinicalTrials.gov, study details are kept up-to-date and basic results are disclosed as required. Creates (and where appropriate, delivers) clinical/protocol training materials for study and site management and for use during site initiation visits and investigator meetings. Helps establish and oversees Data Monitoring Committees (DMCs) and endpoint adjudication committees, including chartering, contracts, provision of relevant data and documentation of outcomes. Jointly accountable with study team for study enrollment and adherence to agreed timelines for study deliverables. Maintains direct contact with investigative sites through site visits, telephone contacts, email etc., in order to facilitate investigator engagement, address investigator questions regarding the protocol or the investigational product, and support enrolment activities. This is done in conjunction with RCSLs (when assigned) for sites outside US, Canada, Japan and China. For some studies the clinician may take on an expanded role as described below for the site liaison responsibilities. Consistent with Safety Review Plan (SRP), performs and documents regular review of individual subject safety data and cumulative safety data with the safety risk lead (as delegated by the China Clinical Program Lead or the Global Clinical Lead). For all studies, clinical safety review should be performed in consultation with a designated medically-qualified Medical Monitor. Responsible for identifying emerging safety trends and raising them forward for further discussion with the Clinical Program Lead and/or Global Clinical Lead; follows up with investigators for specific safety findings (e.g. SAEs). Reviews and manages protocol deviations. Works with study team to ensure high quality of data, e.g. appropriate patient population, adequacy of clinical assessments etc., as study is ongoing. Conducts clinical review and interpretation of efficacy and safety data from clinical trials; this includes delivery of top-line report in collaboration with study statistician, and delivery of clinical study report in collaboration with medical writer; accountable for overall quality and timeliness of analysis and reporting. Responsible for clinical and scientific validity of study report, especially conclusions regarding efficacy and safety. Responsible for disclosure of appropriate safety and efficacy data and conclusions. Ensures narrative strategy for clinical trial(s) is consistent with program narrative strategy; writes (or oversees writingof) safety narratives. Assists in ensuring regulatory compliance for clinical trials and reporting. Contributes to primary publication of clinical trial results. May act as primary contact with external investigators and internal study team for questions relating to the clinical/medical aspects of the protocol. Responsible for keeping the Development China Clinical Program Lead and/or Development China Category Development Lead informed of any critical issues relating to benefit:risk evaluation, or study delivery in line with agreed budget, timelines and quality. Presents to internal and external advisory committees (e.g. Technical Review Committee, advisory boards) on design of clinical trials and data from clinical trials. Site Liaison Responsibilities (if applicable) The China Clinician may have site liaison responsibilities: Serve as clinical site liaison to support trial conduct through virtual meetings or teleconferences (as appropriate) and essential face-to-face contact, working directly with site staff. Maintain the ‘Face of Pfizer’ at each site. Create and maintain positive relationships and enthusiasm. Understand the work environment and key relationships at clinical sites, use analytical and influencing skills to improve communications and collaboration between key stakeholders. Ensure site staff have thorough understanding of protocol requirements (technical and logistic), partner with site staff and study team members to overcome feasibility barriers and operational obstacles and ensure successful subject recruitment/enrollment/retention, protocol compliance and clinical trial quality. Conduct frank discussions and set clear expectations for site performance and monitor site performance through metrics. Identify quality issues and discuss with Pfizer clinical/operations study team members so that corrective actions may be instituted. Escalate protocol-related issues requiring medical expertise to the RCSL or medically-qualified China Clinical Program Lead, if needed. Escalate operational issues to the appropriate operations study team member. Identify the need for and provide supportive coaching and/or training to site staff, as appropriate. Identify methods, techniques, key relationships and logistic approaches employed by most successful sites and translate/transfer these best practices to aspiring sites. General Motivates and engages colleagues in an understanding of disease and commitment and excitement to an indication and mechanism. Coaches and mentors less experienced clinicians; may directly manage clinicians. Maintains and enhances knowledge in relevant disease area and/or technical area (e.g. pediatrics, regional clinical trials) and practice guidelines relevant to the regions in which clinical trials are being conducted. Interfaces with other Pfizer sites, other BUs and other functions to develop and share best practices, as appropriate. May organize expert panel, consultant or advisory board meetings to provide input to protocols, clinical plans or data analysis. jobs.job_description_raw:
Who We Are 
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. 
 What We Offer 
 Location:
Shanghai,CHN 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Support specific project and program objectives as  defined in the areas of responsibility, and that necessary preliminary activities (e.g., determination of outcomes, milestones, viability studies, and resource planning, among others) are completed.
 Support projects and programs assigned are completed in accordance with predetermined requirements, with specific attention to product/process specifications, project/program costs, resource utilization, and timeliness for completion.
 Ensures that all phases of project, program and/or process development are documented and that information required in other functional areas is reported, disseminated, or transferred, as appropriate. Ensures compliance with Company policies regarding Engineering/Lab notebooks, patents, confidentiality and safety.
 Undertake study of new technologies, as appropriate. 
 Support data collection for materials & financial resources.
 Other Requirements: This position may require standing for extended periods of time, walking, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, lifting, the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.
 Additionally, because this position also may involve working in a clean room, the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields may be required. 
 Functional Knowledge 
 Demonstrates expanded conceptual knowledge in own discipline and broadens capabilities
 Business Expertise 
 Understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work
 Leadership 
 No supervisory responsibilities but provides informal guidance to new team members
 Problem Solving 
 Solves problems in straightforward situations; analyzes possible solutions using technical experience and judgment and precedents 
 Impact 
 Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team; works within guidelines and policies
 Interpersonal Skills 
 Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations
 Additional Information

Full time

Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
Yes, 10% of the Time

Yes

jobs.job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递/沟通/反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 1. 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 2. 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 3. 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 4. 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 5. 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 6. 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 7. 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会。 8. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 • 教育： - 具有医学、药学或相关专业大学专科及以上学历。 • 技能： - 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 - 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 • 经验： - 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 • 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 • 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等要求。 核心能力 专业合规: 坚持专业推广-掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规-工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断: 把握市场动态-随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息-合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动: 提供专业支持-积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作-对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行: 高效准确执行-及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务-对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 自我发展: 主动提升能力-把握内外部各种学习机会和资源，不断提升自身的能力和适应力。 创新变革: 积极拥抱变化-用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. jobs.job_description_raw: 1. 制订并执行所辖区域的业务计划，推动团队实现公司和上级经理下达的各项工作目标和任务。 2. 招聘符合公司基本要求的人员（包括各种雇佣形式和编制），定期对团队成员进行绩效和行为的评估，实施奖惩或激励措施。 3. 制订并执行培养团队成员合规意识的计划，规范其工作行为，确保各项活动的真实性和合规性。 4. 制订并执行提升团队成员的专业知识和技能的计划，并对其个人发展规划提供指导与支持。 5. 通过有计划的随访，在与专员讨论区域业务及市场活动时对其进行针对性的辅导。 6. 监控和分析市场发展趋势，挖掘区域市场机会，为公司策略的制订提供反馈和建议。 7. 协调并有效地实施各个项目及活动，合理分配和控制各项资源。有效管理项目和活动的流程，确保其真实有效地开展。 8. 与区域内关键客户保持持续的沟通，建立并持续优化合作伙伴关系。 9. 熟悉对当前及未来业务有影响的政策，必要情况下可根据公司的要求，与相关职能部门合作，参与或协调所辖区域的市场准入工作。 10. 建立和保持有效沟通系统，包括定期召开地区会议，定期与上级经理汇报区域工作进展，与其他部门建立协作关系。 11. 为制订和修改业务相关的政策和流程及其他内部政策提供建议，以实现高效率的业务运作。 12. 支持公司的各项创新举措，带领团队成员执行新举措，并且主动探索创新的机会和方法。 13. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 · 教育： - 大学专科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 · 技能： - 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 - 具备较好的相关产品领域的专业知识。 - 具备较强的影响力和策略性思维能力。 - 具备较强的沟通，计划，组织和问题解决能力。 - 具备较强的团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 · 经验： - 至少 3 年制药行业同等公司的医药代表工作经验，具备符合合规要求的优秀的绩效记录, 具备管理潜力。 - 有制药行业业务管理经验者优先。 · 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 · 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合现行合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等的要求。 - 至少有 2 年以上辉瑞医药代表工作经验；萌芽优先。 - 过去两年的绩效，需达到或超过团队平均水平。 核心能力 专业合规: 打造专业团队 – 评估专员的专业知识和技能的掌握和应用情况，利用各种方式提升团队成员的专业知识和技能。 打造合规团队 – 理解合规各项规定的意义和原则， 培养团队成员的合规意识，规范团队成员的合规行为，防范合规风险。 业务决断: 有效规划业务 – 制定业务计划时既紧密结合大区策略，又把握地区特点和规律。系统分析市场 – 通过对区域市场，客户和政策信息的综合分析形成市场洞察。 客户融动: 优化伙伴关系 – 深入理解并引导客户需求，建立并优化合作伙伴关系。 推动合作共赢 – 理解合作部门的工作目标和重点，当需要时能整合公司资源，推动内部合作。 组织发展: 激发团队士气 – 明确团队管理规则，激发团队士气和凝聚力。 辅导发展他人 – 关注员工的发展， 通过辅导和支持来提升员工的能力。 自主执行: 推动团队达成 – 准确制定团队工作计划，通过监督和跟进推动团队实现目标。 勇于承担责任 – 为团队的绩效结果负责，为实现公司的目标愿意承担起额外责任。 自我发展: 自主规划发展 – 洞察自身优势和不足，制定并执行个人发展计划以促进持续学习，主动寻找并利用提升自身能力的机会和资源。 创新变革: 积极探索创新 – 正确理解并引导团队积极面对各种变化，积极探索工作中的创新机会。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. 职责概述 通过和中央市场部产品组和大区销售管理团队的紧密合作，根据区域市场的发展趋势，整合各方信息，洞察市场机会，制订和执行大区产品推广策略和活动计划，优化客户体系及业务模式，提升大区专业推广能力，从而帮助大区达成或超越各项业务目标。 主要工作和任务 整合分析区域市场信息，掌握区域市场动态和趋势，承接中央市场部的策略，制订有大区特色的推广策略和活动计划，并根据外部政策环境的变化，分析对大区业务的影响，及时提供建议。 跟进评估区域推广活动的执行（频率和质量），合理分配和控制各项资源，持续提升推广效率。 发展和管理区域关键客户，搭建并持续优化合作平台，提升品牌影响力。 通过组织培训，或与MICS和DM协访/共访，指导并落实产品策略执行和产品信息传递。 负责沟通和协调中央市场部项目的执行，对项目的进展和效果提供反馈和建议。 及时向中央市场部提供区域市场动态，大客户反馈等信息以便中央市场部规划或调整市场策略。 在公司政策的指引下申请，筹备和组织相关的内外部会议和活动，汇总并及时反馈各类信息。有效管理会议和活动的流程，确保其真实有效地开展。 制订并执行团队的产品知识和专业技能发展计划，提高团队的专业化推广能力。 主动探索业务创新机会，引领区域的创新项目，推动成功模式的复制。 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 教育： 医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 技能： 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 具备较好的相关产品领域的专业知识。 具备较强的影响力和策略性思维能力。 具备较强的沟通，计划，组织和问题解决能力。 具备较强的团队合作意识。 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 经验： 至少3年制药行业同等公司的销售工作经验，具备符合合规要求的优秀的业绩记录。 有市场或销售管理经验者优先。 诚信： 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于FCPA(《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 内部申请资格： 内部申请人需符合现行合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等要求。 至少有2年以上辉瑞销售工作经验；有销售管理经验优先。 过去两年的销售业绩，达成率&增长率需达到或超过团队平均水平。 核心能力 专业合规: 树立专业影响-整合并创造资源以提升大区整体的专业推广能力，打造专业推广模式。 锻造合规品牌-理解合规各项规定的意义和原则，协助培养团队合规意识，规范团队合规行为，防范合规风险。 业务决断: 洞察市场趋势-进行大区市场分析和布局时，承接中央市场部的策略，同时体现大区市场特色。 挖掘市场机会-整合各方市场信息，通过系统分析把握大区的市场规律并挖掘生意机会。 客户融动: 优化客户体系-有效管理大区KOL，建立KOL人才梯队，把握客户需求，提升品牌影响力。 引导发挥合力-从大区角度推动跨部门合作，主动引导多方协作直至达成目标。 组织发展: 打造专业实力-针对大区人员的实际情况提出切实有效的专业能力优化方案并执行相关培训发展工作。 自主执行: 优化执行方法-积极推动团队执行的同时，不断总结和优化执行方法，并在大区进行推广和复制。积极引领探索。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. Use Your Power for Purpose Every day, our unwavering commitment to quality ensures the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our flexible, innovative, and customer-oriented culture is rooted in science and risk-based compliance. Whether you are engaged in development, maintenance, compliance, or research analysis, your contributions have a direct impact on patient care. By being part of our team, you help uphold a quality culture that adapts and evolves to meet the needs of patients, ensuring that every product we deliver is of the highest standard. What You Will Achieve In this role, you will: Be responsible for the application, maintenance, update and renewal of the site Drug Manufacturing License, organize relevant document preparation, internal review, system submission and regulatory communication, and ensure that changes to licensed items and registered items on the license are applied for and updated in a timely manner in accordance with regulatory requirements. Be responsible for monitoring, identifying, interpreting and communicating laws, regulations, rules, the Chinese Pharmacopoeia and relevant guidelines issued by Chinese drug regulatory authorities; organize applicability assessments and gap analyses; drive and track the development and completion of remediation actions; and ensure that relevant regulatory requirements and national drug standards are effectively implemented at Wuxi site. Act as Local Process Owner (LPO) for Pfizer Quality System processes in compliance area, support communication, assessment and implementation of quality system requirements at Wuxi site, and be responsible for local deployment and execution of relevant processes. Support BoH GMP inspection-related activities, including inspection preparation, document coordination, on-site support, issue clarification, drafting inspection responses, cross-functional communication and follow-up of inspection-related actions, to ensure inspection management and subsequent remediation comply with Pfizer Quality System and regulatory requirements. Act as site internal audit coordinator to coordinate the planning, preparation, execution, response drafting and follow-up action tracking of internal audits at Wuxi site, and drive cross-functional teams to complete assessment, responses and remediation actions for audit observations. Be responsible for material supplier management to ensure supplier management complies with GMP and relevant regulatory requirements. Assist Regulatory Affairs and China CMC team in new product registration, re-registration and post-approval change management, and support the preparation and review of relevant quality documents, site compliance information, license information and regulatory response materials. Be responsible for Annual Product Reports(APRs) activities, including annual report planning, cross-functional information collection, document review, report preparation/submission coordination and follow-up of subsequent questions, to ensure annual drug reports are completed in a timely and accurate manner in accordance with regulatory requirements. Be responsible for coordinating the implementation of quality management review at Wuxi site, including collection of review input materials, consolidation of quality metrics and trend information, meeting organization support, review outputs and follow-up of related actions. Be responsible for site-wide communication, training and promotion of data integrity, and support data integrity risk identification, gap assessment, remediation action tracking and continuous maintenance of good data integrity culture. Complete other related work assigned by Site Compliance Lead. Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements) Bachelor’s degree or above with at least 2 years of drug quality-related experience, majoring in pharmacy, pharmaceutical engineering, biopharmaceuticals, chemistry or a related field. Pharmaceutical professional knowledge and China GMP knowledge, with familiarity with drug manufacturing quality management requirements. Good English reading and writing skills, verbal communication and strong document writing capability. Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements) Experience in quality management, GMP compliance, regulatory affairs, government inspections/internal audits, supplier quality management or registration support in a pharmaceutical manufacturing enterprise is preferred. Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with colleagues at all levels. Cross-functional coordination capability, analytical judgment and problem-solving capability. Adaptability and willingness to continuously learn new techniques and new regulations. Good time management and multitasking capabilities, as well as good teamwork spirit, sense of responsibility and compliance awareness. Strong knowledge of lean manufacturing principles, six sigma methodologies, and statistical analysis Experience using common AI tools, including generative technologies such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, to support problem solving and enhance productivity. Demonstrated curiosity for exploring how these tools can improve outcomes and understanding of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. Who We Are 
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. 
 What We Offer 
 Location:
Shanghai,CHN 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
 Use digital analytics for troubleshooting   
 Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
 Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
 Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
 Minimum Qualifications:   
 Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification   
 Basic mechanical aptitude
 Willing to learn and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
 Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols.
 Preferred Qualifications:   
 1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Associate degree in electronics or engineering technologies
 Knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics
 Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

Full time

New College Grad

Yes, 20% of the Time 
 Relocation Eligible: 
Yes

jobs.normalized_title: Mac 硬件系统设计工程实习生（硬件工程 AI 工具）

jobs.qualifications: 官网列明：5 年以上构建、训练并规模化交付生产级深度学习和 NLP 系统的行业经验。

jobs.qualifications: 官网列明：计算机、信息技术、工程、数据科学、网络安全等相关专业本科及以上或等同经验，且具备 2 年以上相关技术经验。

jobs.job_description_raw:
Who We Are 
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. 
 What We Offer 
 Location:
Shenzhen,CHN 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Assists in planning the daily work schedule within assigned territory to ensure completion of Preventive Maintenance and remedial maintenance.
 Uses escalation policies as required to keep management informed of down situations.
 Verifies and approves the operational quality of system equipment. Performs daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, biannual, and annual periodic maintenance on systems within established time frames. Also performs wet cleans as required. Instructs customers in the operation and maintenance of systems. Troubleshoots and corrects process variations on systems partially with assistance from senior engineers.
 Assumes responsibility for complete customer satisfaction within assigned accounts. Assists in planning, communicating, and co-ordinating support plans with customer management.
 Performs start-up, warranty, paid service, and service contract activities. Performs TIER II start-ups within established time frames. Assists on TIER III start-ups. Provides technical assistance to less experienced Applied personnel. Uses training and experience to identify some process related system problems.
 Serves as the Company liaison with the customer's front line management on administrative and technical matters for assigned projects. Assists in the preparation of and participates in customer meetings.
 Develops and implements plans to increase productivity. Tracks equipment performance and plan uptime improvement. Has a working knowledge of Statistical Process Control. Utilises Quality Improvement Process methods and terminology.
 Plans and executes support activities on a wide range of Applied Materials' systems. May need technical assistance in performance of daily responsibilities.
 Other Requirements : This is a physically demanding position that often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.
 Functional Knowledge 
 Has developed proficiency in a range of analytical processes or procedures to carry out assigned tasks 
 Business Expertise 
 Has a good understanding of how the team integrates with others to achieve objectives
 Leadership 
 May provide informal guidance and support to more junior team members
 Problem Solving 
 Provides solutions to problems in situations that are atypical or infrequently occurring based on existing precedents or procedures
 Impact 
 Impacts the quality of own work and its contribution to the team
 Interpersonal Skills 
 Uses communication skills to regularly exchange information 
 Additional Information 
 Time Type: 
Full time 
 Employee Type: 
Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
Not Specified 
 Relocation Eligible: 
Yes 
 Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.
