Who We Are 
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
 What We Offer 
 Location:
Shanghai,CHN 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.  
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
 Use digital analytics for troubleshooting   
 Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
 Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
 Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
 Minimum Qualifications:   
 Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification
 1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
 Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
 Basic mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics
 Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols
 Preferred Qualifications:   
 2–4 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.   Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.
 Additional Information 
 Time Type: 
Full time 
 Employee Type: 
Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
 Relocation Eligible: 
No

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.  
 SW Applications Engineer: 
 This position is within the process diagnostics and control (PDC) group, which deals with advanced imaging together with cutting edge image processing & AI algorithms and electronic design data to detect, measure and classify nanometer size defects and pattern variations from semiconductor fabrication process steps. As PDC to multi-source data products and AI-based solutions, this engineer plays a central role in both shaping those products and driving their success in the field.
 What You’ll Do 
 Product Performance & Application 
 Maximize the performance of Data Products through deep understanding of customer use-cases and close technical collaboration with R&D, Algorithms, and Product teams
 Extend applicative expertise across multiple data sources (CAD, design, process, inspection) and beyond LINK to the full PDC product portfolio
 Ensure applicative value and readiness of SW and algorithmic solutions prior to and during field deployment
 Field Execution & Customer Success 
 Drive adoption and integrated deployment of Data Product solutions at leading semiconductor fabs worldwide
 Serve as the technical escalation point for complex field issues, providing rapid resolution and root cause analysis
 Develop utilities and scripts (Python) for debugging, workflow automation, and issue isolation
 Innovation & Roadmap Contribution 
 Conceptualize and prototype technical flows that convert multi-source data into new applications and insights
 Translate Voice of Customer (VoC) and field learnings into concrete product requirements and roadmap inputs
 Explore and validate AI/ML-based approaches that advance PDC's data product capabilities
 What We Offer 
 Opportunity to work on cutting-edge semiconductor technology and products. 
 Direct collaboration with customers and global R&D teams
 A role with real product influence — your field learnings shape the roadmap
 Dual career track: technical specialist or engineering leadership
 A culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous learning
 What You Bring 
 Master’s / Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, VLSI, or a related field
 2–5 years of experience in semiconductor process and defectivity, with hands-on knowledge of CAD and design-based inspection concepts
 Proficiency in Python; experience building scripts, tools, or analytical workflows
 Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and practical experience applying them to data analysis or product development
 Comfort with GenAI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) for code generation, debugging, and documentation
 Willingness to travel ~50% to leading fabs globally
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams
 Excellent communication skills — equally effective with customers, field teams, and R&D engineers

Full time

 Field Quality Engineer 
 About the Role 
 We are seeking a Field Quality Engineer (FQE) to improve service quality, customer satisfaction, and equipment reliability across our installed base. This role serves as the link between field service teams, engineering, manufacturing, quality organizations, and customers to identify recurring issues, drive root-cause investigations, and implement sustainable corrective actions. Reporting into Global Field Quality and joining a growing global network of Field Quality Engineers, this is an opportunity for a confident, proactive professional who thrives engaging directly with quality organizations and customers — including close partnership with Customer Quality Engineers (CQEs) as key regional counterparts.
 The ideal candidate combines strong technical problem-solving skills with a passion for continuous improvement, operational excellence, and customer success.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Analyze field service data, customer feedback, equipment performance trends, and recurring issue patterns to identify quality improvement opportunities.
 Coach field team on root-cause investigations and corrective actions for escalations and recurring product/service issues.
 Partner with field service, engineering, manufacturing, customer quality, supplier quality, and business unit teams to resolve complex technical problems.
 Improve the quality and completeness of service documentation, lessons learned, and knowledge assets to enable effective troubleshooting and knowledge sharing.
 Develop and track quality metrics, dashboards, and action plans to drive continuous improvement.
 Drive lessons learned, best practices, and knowledge reuse across the organization.
 Drive field quality capability development by reinforcing quality training, coaching teams on problem-solving methodologies, and promoting consistent adoption of quality processes and best practices.
 Support product introductions, ramp readiness activities, and field reliability improvement initiatives.
 Promote quality culture, first-time-right behaviors, issue ownership, and continuous improvement within the field organization.
 We strongly encourage internal candidates — including current Quality Ambassadors, Customer Engineers, and Field Service Managers — to apply, as this role offers a natural next step for those with field quality experience and a passion for driving service excellence. 
 Qualifications 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent field experience.
 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or field service engineering (e.g., Customer Engineer, Field Service Manager), manufacturing, customer support, or a related technical role. Quality engineering and field service engineering experience are considered equally relevant.
 Experience leading root-cause investigations and corrective actions.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret technical data and identify trends.
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
 Ability to work effectively across multiple functions and influence without direct authority.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience in semiconductor equipment, capital equipment, high-tech manufacturing, or a related industry.
 Knowledge of quality management systems and continuous improvement methodologies.
 Experience with customer-facing technical support or escalation management.
 Familiarity with reliability engineering, failure analysis, and data-driven problem solving.
 ASQ, Lean Six Sigma, or other quality-related certifications.
 Success in This Role 
 Successful candidates will: 
 Improve equipment reliability and service quality.
 Reduce repeat failures and recurring customer issues.
 Increase first-time-right resolution rates.
 Improve response times and issue closure effectiveness.
 Strengthen collaboration between service, engineering, and quality organizations.
 Drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction and operational performance.
 Why Join Us? 
 This role offers the opportunity to directly impact customer success by transforming field experience into product and service improvements. You will work with cross-functional teams to solve complex technical challenges, improve reliability, strengthen service execution, and help deliver world-class customer outcomes in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.

Full time

Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
Not Specified

No

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

As a Process Support Engineer (PSE), you'll play a critical role in guiding products through their entire lifecycle, from initial concept to final qualification. You will provide high-visibility customer support through on-site installations, system diagnoses, and the service and repair of complex systems and equipment. PSEs work closely with customers and R&D teams to develop leading-edge processes used to manufacture advanced semiconductor chips, and create hypothesis experiments and design of experiments (DOEs). You'll analyze data with statistics and compile reports with high-level conclusions on technically challenging process engineering experiments. Additionally, you will troubleshoot complex problems, perform root cause analyses, and resolve difficult process engineering and customer product issues. Process Support Engineers work across technologies such as: Chemical Vapor Deposition, Atomic Layer Deposition, Plasma Reactive Ion Etch, Physical Vapor Deposition, Anneal and Implant.  
 岗位地点：北京，上海，合肥，深圳，西安

 负责客户端半导体工艺支持，包括新设备工艺验证、工艺调试、验收支持及量产导入相关工作
 针对客户现场复杂工艺问题，开展数据分析、失效机理判断、根因定位及改善方案制定，推动问题闭环解决
 根据新产品、新应用或客户工艺需求，开发、优化半导体设备工艺参数，支持客户达成工艺性能、良率及整合目标
 根据公司内部或客户需求，设计并执行技术实验，收集、处理和分析实验数据，形成技术报告、总结材料或客户沟通资料
 与客户工艺、设备、整合团队及公司内部工程、应用、产品团队合作，及时推进工艺相关问题解决和项目进展
 为客户提供设备工艺相关的设备配置设置、工艺菜单操作规范及工艺参数维护要点相关技术指导，支持客户正确使用设备并提升工艺稳定性

 遵守公司及客户现场的安全、环保、质量和信息保密要求

As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.  
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Install, maintain, and upgrade customer equipment
 Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with assistance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] and/or the customer to understand roadmaps, process flows, inflection points, requirements, and business challenges   
 Train and mentor junior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems
 Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
 Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
 Minimum Qualifications:   
 Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification
 4-7 years of work experience in semiconductor industry or other equipment support industry
 Advanced mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, and/or thermodynamics
 Strong knowledge of hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.   Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.   
 Additional Information 
 Time Type: 
Full time 
 Employee Type: 
Assignee / Regular 
 Travel: 
Yes, 20% of the Time 
 Relocation Eligible: 
Yes

As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.  
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Install, maintain, and upgrade customer equipment
 Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with assistance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] and/or the customer to understand roadmaps, process flows, inflection points, requirements, and business challenges   
 Train and mentor junior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems
 Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
 Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
 Minimum Qualifications:   
 Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification
 4-7 years of work experience in semiconductor industry or other equipment support industry
 Advanced mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, and/or thermodynamics
 Strong knowledge of hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.   Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

As a Process Support Engineer (PSE), you'll play a critical role in guiding products through their entire lifecycle, from initial concept to final qualification. You will provide high-visibility customer support through on-site installations, system diagnoses, and the service and repair of complex systems and equipment. PSEs work closely with customers and R&D teams to develop leading-edge processes used to manufacture advanced semiconductor chips, and create hypothesis experiments and design of experiments (DOEs). You'll analyze data with statistics and compile reports with high-level conclusions on technically challenging process engineering experiments. Additionally, you will troubleshoot complex problems, perform root cause analyses, and resolve difficult process engineering and customer product issues. Process Support Engineers work across technologies such as: Chemical Vapor Deposition, Atomic Layer Deposition, Plasma Reactive Ion Etch, Physical Vapor Deposition, Anneal and Implant.  
 A senior individual contributor process engineering position focused on Front End Products (FEP) and Epitaxy (EPI) semiconductor processes

 Act as the primary technical interface between customers and the Applied Materials Business Unit.

 Strong technical expertise in Epitaxy and related front-end semiconductor processes.

 Position Summary 
 As part of a centralized Employee Relations (ER) Center of Excellence, this role serves as a trusted advisor to business leaders, HR Business Partners, Global Employment Law (GEL), and cross-functional stakeholders on complex employee relations matters. The position is responsible for independently leading workplace investigations, performance and conduct management cases, and employee risk mitigation efforts while ensuring compliance with employment laws, company policies, and organizational values. 
 The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in employee relations investigations, performance management, stakeholder consultation, and labor law compliance within a multinational environment. This individual must be comfortable navigating sensitive and high-risk situations, influencing senior leaders, and balancing employee, legal, and business considerations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Employee Relations & Investigations 
 Lead end-to-end employee relations investigations from intake through fact-finding, interviews, evidence analysis, findings, recommendations, and case closure. 
 Handle complex and sensitive matters, including harassment, discrimination, retaliation, workplace misconduct, conflicts of interest, ethics concerns, and policy violations. 
 Conduct independent investigations and prepare clear, objective, and well-documented investigation reports and recommendations. 
 Partner closely with Global Employment Law, Ethics & Compliance, Security, and HR stakeholders on high-risk or escalated employee matters. 
 Assess legal, reputational, operational, and employee-related risks and provide recommendations to support informed decision-making. 
 Performance & Conduct Management 
 Serve as a subject matter expert on employee performance, conduct, disciplinary actions, and involuntary separations. 
 Advise and coach managers on difficult employee situations, including performance improvement plans (PIPs), misconduct investigations, corrective actions, and terminations. 
 Ensure consistent and legally compliant application of policies and employment practices across employee populations. 
 Support leaders in managing complex performance and behavior-related concerns while balancing business objectives and employee experience. 
 Consultation, Partnership & Coaching 
 Act as a trusted advisor to HRBPs and business leaders on employee relations strategy, risk management, and workplace conflict resolution. 
 Influence and coach leaders at all organizational levels through complex and sensitive employee situations. 
 Partner effectively with HR Centers of Excellence, Legal, Compliance, Security, and regional HR teams to drive consistent employee relations practices. 
 Foster productive relationships across diverse cultures and stakeholder groups within a matrixed global organization. 
 Global Collaboration & Compliance 
 Support employee relations matters involving regional and global stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions. 
 Interpret and apply employment laws, regulations, and company policies to ensure compliant business practices. 
 Prepare professional reports, business communications, and case summaries for regional and global leadership audiences. 
 Monitor external labor and employment trends and recommend proactive risk mitigation strategies. 
 Data, Metrics & Continuous Improvement 
 Track and analyze ER case metrics, trends, root causes, and organizational risks. 
 Identify opportunities to improve employee relations processes, policies, governance, and manager effectiveness. 
 Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance investigation quality, case management, and employee experience. 
 Training & Enablement 
 Develop and deliver training programs for managers, HR teams, and stakeholders on employee relations, investigations, performance management, and workplace conduct. 
 Build organizational capability in managing employee issues proactively and consistently. 
 Partner with GEL and HR stakeholders to enhance ER-related tools, resources, and manager readiness. 
 Skills & Competencies 
 Advanced workplace investigation and fact-finding skills. 
 Strong expertise in employee relations, performance management, and conduct management. 
 Exceptional consulting, influencing, stakeholder management, and coaching capabilities. 
 Sound judgment and demonstrated ability to balance legal, employee, and business risks. 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare investigation reports and executive-level recommendations. 
 Ability to manage highly sensitive and confidential matters with discretion and professionalism. 
 Executive presence with the ability to influence leaders in complex and ambiguous situations. 
 Collaborative, culturally agile, and effective in multinational and matrixed environments. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify patterns, root causes, and organizational risks.

 Knowledge & Experience

Responsibilities overview 零售地区经理，负责区域销售工作。包括制定和实施区域的业务目标和发展计划，建立一个业绩良好、极富生产力和士气高昂的团队。对区域客户的需求做出适当反应以达成或超越区域的各项业务目标，对区域代表的行为进行规范和监管，对他们的专业技能提升和学习发展规划提供辅导和支持。 Main tasks 1. 制订并执行所辖区域的业务计划，完成年度销售目标，推动团队完成或超越完成公司和上级经理下达的各项工作目标和任务。 2. 招聘符合公司基本要求的人员(包括各种雇佣形式和编制)，定期对团队成员进行绩效和行为评估，实施有效的激励措施。 3. 制订并执行培养团队成员合规意识的计划，规范其工作行为，确保各项活动的真实性和合规性。 4. 制订并执行提升团队成员的专业知识和技能的计划，并对其个人发展规划提供指导与支持。 5. 通过有计划的随访，在与专员及代表讨论区域销售及市场活动时对其进行针对性的辅导。 6. 监控和分析市场发展趋势，挖掘区域市场机会，为公司策略的制订提供反馈和建议。 7. 协调并有效地实施各个项目及活动，合理分配和控制各项资源。有效管理项目和活动的流程，确保其真实有效地开展。 8. 与区域内关键客户保持持续的沟通，建立并持续优化合作伙伴关系。 9. 熟悉对当前及未来业务有影响的政策，必要情况下可根据公司的要求，与相关职能部门合作，参与或协调所辖区域的市场准入工作。 10. 建立和保持有效沟通系统，包括定期召开地区会议，定期与上级经理汇报区域工作进展，与其他部门建立协作关系。 11. 为制订和修改销售相关的政策和流程及其他内部政策提供建议，以实现高效率的销售运作。 12. 支持公司的各项创新举措，带领团队成员执行新举措，并且主动探索创新的机会和方法。 13.完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 Job Requirements · 教育： 具有医学、药学或相关专业大学专科及以上学历 · 工作经验： 外部应聘者需5年或以上制药行业同等公司的销售工作经验 有3年以上销售管理经验者优先 · 技能： u 良好的沟通表达、写作能力和办公软件操作技能。 u 具备较好的相关产品领域的专业知识。 u 具备较强的影响力和策略性思维能力。 u 具备较强的沟通，计划，组织和问题解决能力。 u 具有较强的团队合作意识。 u 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 u 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 · 诚信： u 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 · 内部申请资格： 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等要求。 Key Capabilities 专业合规: 坚持专业推广-掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。 严格坚守合规-工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断: 有效规划业务 – 制定业务计划时既紧密结合公司策略，又把握客户特点和区域规律。 系统分析市场 – 通过对市场，客户和政策信息的综合分析形成市场洞察。 客户融动: 优化伙伴关系 – 深入理解并引导客户需求，建立并优化合作伙伴关系。 推动合作共赢 – 理解合作部门的工作目标和重点，当需要时能整合公司资源，推动内部合作。 自主执行: 高效准确执行 –准确制定工作计划，及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 勇于承担责任 – 为业绩结果负责，为实现公司的目标愿意承担起额外责任。 自我发展: 自主规划发展 – 洞察自身优势和不足，制定并执行个人发展计划以促进持续学习，主动寻找并利用提升自身能力的机会和资源。 创新变革： 积极拥抱变化-用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. Position Overview The Customer Engagement Excellence Lead is responsible for the strategic design, transformation, and optimization of omnichannel customer engagement initiatives that accelerate business objectives and drive GTM (Go-to-Market) excellence. This role collaborates closely with cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex customer needs and business challenges into actionable engagement strategies, leveraging advanced analytics, digital technologies, and best-in-class omnichannel practices. The incumbent will deliver scalable, high-impact engagement programs and transformation projects supporting both operational excellence and organizational innovation. Key Responsibilities Lead the planning and execution of omnichannel engagement optimization and transformation initiatives in partnership with BU, GTM transformation teams and cross-function teams, ensuring alignment with business strategic priorities. Collect, analyze, and document customer journey data and engagement requirements from business units, marketing, sales, and digital channels, identifying opportunities for integration and process enhancement. Develop and implement robust omnichannel engagement frameworks, including digital channel architecture, governance, and stewardship, to ensure quality, security, and compliance across all customer touchpoints. Design and deploy integrated engagement solutions, leveraging data lakes, CRM platforms, and automated pipelines to consolidate customer intelligence for advanced analytics and personalized engagement use cases. Drive the centralization and optimization of customer engagement assets and oversee the enhancement of data collection methodologies (including tracking, tagging, and channel attribution designs) to enable actionable business insights. Automate and streamline engagement reporting processes, delivering timely dashboards, scorecards, and metrics tailored to omnichannel transformation objectives. Partner with internal digital, and commercial teams to ensure the successful and timely delivery of engagement platforms, tools, and analytics that meet evolving business needs. Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in omnichannel engagement, digital marketing, and customer analytics, proposing innovative approaches for continuous improvement. Provide expert analysis, strategic recommendations, and data-driven insights to support leadership decision-making in customer engagement, digital innovation, and business model optimization. Maintain rigorous compliance with internal standards, data privacy regulations, and industry best practices, consistently demonstrating the highest level of ethics and professionalism to safeguard Pfizer’s reputation and market leadership. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or above in Marketing, Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Management, Digital Marketing, or a related discipline; Master’s preferred. Minimum of 8 years’ professional experience in customer engagement, omnichannel marketing, or digital transformation, with at least 3 years’ proven track record in cross-functional project management within multinational or highly regulated environments; prior experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry is highly desirable. Advanced proficiency in digital engagement platforms, CRM systems, business intelligence (BI), big data and marketing cloud technologies. Demonstrated strategic thinking, strong business acumen, and a results-oriented approach to customer-centric decision-making. Comprehensive understanding of pharmaceutical GTM strategies, omnichannel engagement, sales and marketing analytics, and the application of data insights to drive commercial growth. Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and drive collaboration across multiple teams and cultures; fluency in both English and Mandarin is highly advantageous. Direct experience with omnichannel optimization or digital transformation projects, preferably within a global pharmaceutical or healthcare context. 职责概述 通过和中央市场部产品组和大区销售管理团队的紧密合作，根据区域市场的发展趋势，整合各方信息，挖掘市场机会，制定和执行大区产品推广策略和活动计划，优化客户体系及业务模式，提升大区专业推广能力，从而帮助大区达成或超越各项业务目标。 主要工作和任务 整合分析区域市场信息，掌握区域市场动态和趋势，承接中央市场部的策略，制定有大区特色的推广策略和活动计划，并根据外部政策环境的变化，分析对大区业务的影响，及时提供建议。 跟进评估区域推广活动的执行（频率和质量），合理分配和控制各项资源，持续提升推广效率。 发展和管理区域关键客户，搭建并持续优化合作平台，提升品牌影响力。 通过组织培训，或与MICS和DM协访/共访，指导并落实产品策略执行和产品信息传递。 负责沟通和协调中央市场部项目的执行，对项目的进展和效果提供反馈和建议。 在公司政策的指引下申请，筹备和组织相关的内外部会议和活动，汇总并及时反馈各类信息。有效管理会议和活动的流程，确保其真实有效地开展。 制定并执行团队的产品知识和专业技能发展计划，提高团队的专业化推广的能力。 主动探索业务创新机会，引领区域的创新项目，推动成功模式复制。 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 教育： 大学专科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 技能： 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 具备较好的相关产品领域的专业知识。 具备较强的影响力和策略性思维能力。 具备较强的沟通，计划，组织和问题解决能力。 具备较强的团队合作意识。 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 经验： 至少3年制药行业同等公司的销售工作经验，具备符合合规要求的优秀的业绩记录。 有市场或销售管理经验者优先。 诚信： 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 内部申请资格： 内部申请人需符合现行合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等要求。 至少有2年以上辉瑞销售工作经验；有销售管理经验优先，萌芽优先。 过去两年的销售业绩，达成率/增长率需达到或超过团队平均水平。 核心能力 专业合规: 树立专业影响-整合并创造资源以提升大区整体的专业推广能力，打造专业推广模式。 锻造合规品牌-理解合规各项规定的意义和原则，协助培养团队合规意识，规范团队合规行为，防范合规风险。 业务决断: 洞察市场趋势-进行大区市场分析和布局时，承接中央市场部的策略，同时体现大区市场特色。 挖掘市场机会-整合各方市场信息，通过系统分析把握大区的市场规律并挖掘生意机会。 客户融动: 优化客户体系-有效管理大区KOL，建立KOL人才梯队，把握客户需求，提升品牌影响力。 引导发挥合力-从大区角度推动跨部门合作，主动引导多方协作直至达成目标。 组织发展: 打造专业实力-针对大区人员的实际情况提出切实有效的专业能力优化方案并执行相关培训发展工作。 自主执行: 优化执行方法-积极推动团队执行的同时，不断总结和优化执行方法，并在大区进行推广和复制。积极引领探索。 自我发展: 自主规划发展-洞察自身优势和不足，制定并执行个人发展计划以促进持续学习，主动寻找并利用提升自身能力的机会和资源。 创新变革： 根据市场发展趋势，帮助团队建立创新业务模式或及时优化现有业务模式并进行推广。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. 目的 为了安全、及时、保质保量的完成各种生产任务，在符合公司质量标准，国家药品、食品质量标准、安全及劳动法规条件下，参加各类注册产品的生产。 职责范围 一. 生产运行 根据相关标准操作规程（SOP）及批生产记录的要求完成无菌生产工作。根据数据完整性要求填写岗位日志及批记录。为了满足市场对产品产量和质量的需求，充分利用各种资源，协调并参与无菌生产使之有序进行。 二. 参与批记录的审核，思爱普系统（SAP）中物料的领料、退料；SOP的修改及起草; 组织协调工序内的生产活动；培训新员工以及定期对岗位员工进行岗位工作考核。 三. 产品质量控制 确保生产过程中各环节符合药品生产质量管理规范（GMP）要求及公司总部辉瑞质量标准（PQS）要求，所有操作按标准操作规程执行，使产品质量得到有效保证。 四. 设备维护与管理 参与并带领工序人员进行日常的设备使用、清洁、维护，使设备处于有效运行与管理之中。 五. 安全与卫生 具有安全和卫生相关知识，保证生产的安全进行，保证生产现场清洁卫生，符合国家及公司要求，遵守相应的管理措施。 六. 新产品、新设备与新工艺 参与并协助管理团队进行新产品试制和新设备的调试。 七. 团队精神 为了完成团队共同目标，团结其它员工，达成共同目标。 八. 人员培训及发展、员工纪律 协助管理人员制定培训规程及计划，并通过合适的程序保证员工得到有效的培训。 九. 改进生产工艺，提高效率 提高生产效率、发挥生产能力、稳定产品质量，对工艺、设备、流程等进行不断的改进与完善，满足不断的发展需求。 十. 遵守公司有关环境、健康、安全（EHS）相关政策和规定，并完成EHS相关工作进行验证及新验证项目的实施 十一. 按照工厂工作制度要求，能根据排班适应早，中，夜班等特殊工时工作制的作息时间。 任职要求 1. 教育程度/经验: 中专具有5-7年以上制药生产技术经验，制药/化工相关专业； 大专具有3-5年以上制药生产技术经验，制药/化工相关专业； 本科，制药/化工相关专业； 2. 特别知识 制药专业知识， GMP专门知识，验证知识，其它国家药品法规，劳动法、环保法等。 3. 技能： 良好的沟通能力和团队精神及分析判断能力； 良好的英语综合能力，熟练使用计算机并会操作OFFICE办公软件； 具有不断学习/接受新知识的能力； 具有同时进行并完成多种任务的能力。 Purpose In order to complete the production task safely，timely and high-qualitative, the staff should participate in the production of all kinds of registered products in accord with the company’s quality standards, the national drug and food quality standards, safety and labor laws. Responsibility scope A. Production operation Conduct aseptic production operation according to the relative Standard Operation Procedure (SOP) and batch record. Record the logbook and batch record according to the data integrity requirement. Meet the market need, make full use of various resources, coordinate and participate in aseptic production and make sure production go smoothly. B. Take part in batch record review. Material receiving and return in SAP system. Responsible for drafting or revising SOP. Organize and coordinate the production activities in the position process; Train new employees and conduct regular assessment position employees. Comply with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements, the company headquarter’ s Pfizer Quality Standards (PQS) requirements. Operate according to the standards, operation procedure, so that the product quality is effectively guaranteed. C. Product quality control Ensure production process meet the Current GMP requirements, PQS requirements. Operate according to the standards, operation procedure, so that the product quality is effectively guaranteed. D. Equipment maintenance and management Participate in and lead process personnel Cleaning and maintaining the equipment in the daily operation. E. Safety and health Have safety and health knowledge to ensure the safety of production, the staff should ensure the production site clean, conform to the requirements and comply with the relevant management measures. F. New products, new equipment and new technology Participate in and cooperate with management team to finish new product development and new equipment debugging. G. Team spirit. Build up an effective team to accomplish team’s targets H. Personnel training and development. Cooperate with management team prepare training procedures and plan to ensure that the staff s get appropriate training before taking the job. I. Improve production process and efficiency. Improve the production efficiency, production capacity, stability of product quality, he should improve and perfect the technology, equipment, process and so on and meet the developing needs. J. Comply with company policies and regulations related to EHS, and responsible for department Environment, Health, Safety (EHS) work. K. Cooperate to conduct annual re-validation and new project's validation work. L. In accordance with the factory's work system requirements, one should be able to adapt to special work schedules such as early, mid, and night shifts based on the shift schedule. Job requirements 1. Education Background/ Experience： 5-7 Years Aseptic process experience with Technical Secondary Diploma. 3-5Years Aseptic process experience with College Diploma. 0-2 Years Aseptic process experience bachelor's degree. Major in pharmaceutical or chemical engineering. 2. Special Knowledge： Pharmaceutical expertise, GMP expertise, validation knowledge, other national druglaws, labor law, environmental law, etc. 3. Skills： Good communication skills and team spirit and ability to analyze and judge. Good English comprehensive ability and good at using computer and can operate OFFICE software; Ability to continuously learn and accept new knowledge; Ability to perform multiple tasks at the same time. Coordination, communication skills, analytical skills and teamwork ability. jobs.job_description_raw:
Who We Are 
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
 What We Offer 
 Location:
Hangzhou,CHN 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.  
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
 Use digital analytics for troubleshooting   
 Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
 Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
 Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
 Minimum Qualifications:   
 Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification   
 Basic mechanical aptitude
 Willing to learn and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
 Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols.
 Preferred Qualifications:   
 1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Associate degree in electronics or engineering technologies
 Knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics
 Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.   
 Additional Information 
 Time Type: 
Full time 
 Employee Type: 
New College Grad 
 Travel: 
Yes, 20% of the Time 
 Relocation Eligible: 
Yes 
 Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

As a Manufacturing Technician, you'll work hands-on in a cleanroom environment to build and test our multimillion-dollar display and wafer fabrication equipment that’s behind the technology we use every day. You'll be responsible for building, repairing, and testing various types of equipment--including electrical, electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies, subassemblies, and components. You will perform electro-mechanical assembly operations, troubleshooting, and repairs-- and perform audits to ensure necessary parts are available and inspected for defects. Using test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors, and vacuum pumps you'll test assemblies, complete documentation, perform repairs, or install software to continuously improve our processes.  
 Role Responsibilities:  
 Use work orders (including schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and instructions) to build, repair and/or test equipment of various kinds (electrical, electro-mechanical, vacuum, pneumatic assemblies, subassemblies and components) 
 Work under moderate supervision to perform electro-mechanical assembly operations, troubleshooting and repairs 
 Receive parts and perform audits to ensure all necessary parts are available; inspect parts for defects; troubleshoot and improve processes 
 Use test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors and/or vacuum pumps to test assemblies, subassemblies and components 
 Complete required job documentation (data entry) about progress, work expense and labor details; perform computer programming, repair or software installs, if needed 
 Work closely with engineers on new projects developing and testing. and provide inputs and feedback.
 Assist supervisor in aligning resources for daily production needs.
 Minimum Qualifications:  
 Bachelor’s degree
 2–4 years of semiconductor or display experience, or comparable industry or military experience 
 Candidates must possess strong English reading and writing skills, with the ability to understand technical documentation.
 Ability to follow standard operation procedures (written and verbal)
 Preferred Qualifications:   
 Bachelor’s degree
 5 years or above of related experience
 A willingness to expand your skills within an analytical/scientific method or operational process 
 Solid analytical skills, and an ability to problem-solve using established operating procedures or scientific methods 
 Electrical Safety Chinese Government Training Certification
 Precision Workmanship Certification
 Physical Requirements:  
This is a physically demanding position that often requires standing for extended periods of time, walking, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting, the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, the use of hand and power tools, and driving or operating heavy machinery including forklifts.  Additionally, because this position may involve working in a clean room, the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields may be required.

The Digital and Automation Data Integration & Systems Senior Engineer drives and contributes to the reliable, compliant, and efficient use of data across site Digital and Automation environments. The role focuses on focuses on coordinating execution of site-level data strategy, data standards, and system integrations in line with broader network strategies and global standards. The role also enables AI adoption by ensuring data foundations and supporting the deployment and scaling of AI-driven use cases across site operations. This role drives and contributes to day-to-day execution, lifecycle, and project activities related to data systems, historians, integrations, and local applications. Working closely with system owners, engineering, project teams, validation, and business stakeholders, this role enables and optimises consistent data flows across core platforms while maintaining compliance, validation, and inspection readiness. The Senior Engineer provides technical guidance within defined scope, escalating to the DIS Team Lead where cross-site or strategic alignment is required. Responsibilities Data Strategy, Standards & Governance Coordinate and contribute to the development, documentation, and execution of the site end-to-end data strategy in alignment with network direction. Apply and reinforce data standards, enhancing deployment and adherence to ensure consistency, integrity, and compliance in how data is structured, stored, and used. Ensure data-related work is executed in line with applicable quality, validation, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements, following established SOPs and governance processes. Contributes to and interprets global data standards for local implementation by providing site operational knowledge undefined System Integration & Data Flow Enablement Design, execute and support core system integrations, ensuring optimised, secure, and compliant data flow and connectivity across system layers Monitor and support data connectivity, proactively identifying and resolving integration issues, data quality gaps, or performance risks within defined scope, escalating where appropriate. Execute and improve implementation, configuration, and lifecycle management of site historians and data platforms to enable operational reporting, analytics, and continuous improvement. Develop, enhance and rationalise local application lifecycle management, including development, configuration, upgrade, enhancements, rationalization, retirement and archiving as well as connectivity to data sources Maintain accurate asset, configuration, and data mapping documentation to support lifecycle management, validation, and inspection readiness. Participate in incident, deviation, and recovery activities to ensure timely restoration of services while maintaining data integrity and validated state control. Provide technical review and guidance on integration and solution design decisions within site scope. undefined AI, Analytics & Innovation Enablement Partner with site operational, process teams and digital innovation teams to implement data-driven use cases, translating business problems into data requirements. Enable use of data for analytics, AI, and innovation initiatives by ensuring data availability, reliability, and alignment to defined standards. Support scaling and industrialization of AI and analytics use cases. Key Attributes, Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of data architecture, system integration patterns, and data lifecycle management Fluent in English and Chinese Understands and applies data governance and quality principles and their application in manufacturing environments — accuracy, completeness, traceability, and timeliness. Strong knowledge of GxP data integrity requirements and their implications for manufacturing data systems including digital and automation platforms, and cross-system data flows. Experience with local application development and system connectivity, with the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, AI and Automation. Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with automation, IT, quality, and business partners to deliver shared outcomes. Drives a continuous improvement mindset, seeking opportunities to simplify, standardize, and optimize data flows. Supports and mentors team members in data systems, integration practices, and standards adoption. Balances performance, compliance, and delivery priorities when designing and implementing solutions. Preferred Qualifications, Experience & Certifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Life Sciences, or related technical field 2-4 years’ experience in information technology systems/infrastructure or specialist knowledge of process automation/process control systems 1-2 years in a regulated manufacturing environment (pharma or similar preferred) Experience with Lean/Operational Excellence Project/program management (PMI, Agile, SDLC) and continuous improvement (e.g., Six Sigma) IT infrastructure management (e.g., ITIL) and GMP regulatory requirements experience preferred undefined Work Location Assignment: Hybrid Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. Position Overview The Patient Product Manager is responsible for designing, developing, and managing patient-centric digital products powered by AI and emerging technologies that enhance patient experience, engagement, and health outcomes across Pfizer China's commercial portfolio. Reporting to the GTMx Solution Lead for Commercial AI Innovation, this role bridges the gap between commercial strategy, medical science, and digital product innovation — driving meaningful, compliant, and human-centered engagement with patients at scale. The incumbent will define and execute the patient product roadmap, lead cross-functional product delivery, and champion the patient perspective within Pfizer China's AI transformation agenda. Key Responsibilities Patient Product Strategy Define and execute the patient product roadmap aligned with Pfizer China's commercial priorities and AI innovation strategy, identifying high-impact opportunities to improve patient engagement, education, treatment adherence, and health outcomes through digital solutions. Develop compelling product business cases and strategic proposals that secure senior leadership endorsement and cross-functional resource commitment. Product Development Lifecycle Lead end-to-end product development from opportunity identification and concept design through build, pilot, launch, scale, and iteration — following agile product development principles and structured stage-gate governance. Define product vision, user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature prioritization frameworks, collaborating closely with digital engineering, UX design, medical, and commercial teams to deliver products that meet user needs and business objectives. Patient Insights & Research Conduct and synthesize patient journey research, voice-of-patient studies, ethnographic research, and competitive market analysis to develop deep understanding of patient needs, pain points, information gaps, and behavioral drivers. Translate patient insights into actionable product requirements and design principles, ensuring every product decision is anchored in real-world patient experience and validated with target users. AI-Powered Product Innovation Leverage artificial intelligence, machine learning, personalization engines, conversational AI (chatbots/virtual health assistants), and generative AI technologies to create differentiated, scalable, and adaptive patient engagement solutions. Monitor and evaluate emerging AI technologies and digital health innovations for applicability to patient product development, proposing pilot initiatives to explore and validate new approaches. Cross-functional Collaboration Partner with brand/marketing teams, medical affairs, regulatory/legal, compliance, IT, patient advocacy, and external technology vendors and agencies to ensure products are scientifically sound, commercially impactful, and fully compliant. Serve as the patient product lead within cross-functional squads, facilitating alignment on scope, timelines, dependencies, and risk management across all stakeholder groups. Product Performance Management Define product KPIs, usage metrics, outcome measures, and patient satisfaction indicators; build analytics dashboards and reporting frameworks to enable ongoing performance monitoring and data-driven product decisions. Establish structured feedback loops — including user testing, patient advisory panels, and real-world evidence review — to continuously improve product features, usability, and health impact. Market Landscape & Competitive Intelligence Monitor patient digital product trends, competitive offerings, technology developments, and regulatory changes in pharmaceutical patient engagement; identify whitespace opportunities for product differentiation and innovation. Build and maintain an external intelligence network spanning technology partners, patient communities, academic institutions, and healthcare ecosystem players to inform product strategy. Regulatory & Compliance Ensure all patient products comply with NMPA regulations, Pfizer's global product development standards, data privacy requirements (PIPL/GDPR principles), and applicable pharmaceutical promotional guidelines throughout the productlifecycle. Engage proactively with legal, compliance, and medical review processes, building compliant-by-design products that maintain the highest standards of patient safety and data protection. Stakeholder Communication Present product strategies, roadmap updates, performance results, and business case recommendations to senior leadership and cross-functional governance forums; champion the patient perspective in all commercial decision-making. Develop and maintain clear internal product documentation (product briefs, roadmap decks, feature specs) that enables efficient cross-functional alignment and handoff. Qualifications Bachelor's degree or above in Business, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Digital Health, Human-Computer Interaction, Health Informatics, or a related field; Master's degree preferred. Minimum 5 years of professional experience in product management, digital health product development, or commercial strategy roles within pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare technology sectors. Proven track record in developing and launching digital products or patient engagement programs — from concept through live product — with hands-on experience in product design, user research, agile development, and product analytics. Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical patient journey, chronic disease management, treatment adherence, and the regulatory landscape for patient-facing digital health products in China. Familiarity with AI/ML tools, digital health platforms, CRM systems, patient engagement technologies, and remote patient monitoring solutions; direct experience with generative AI product applications is a significant plus. Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven approach to product prioritization and decision-making; experience with product analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude) and A/B testing methodologies. Strong project management skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent product workstreams, competing priorities, and diverse stakeholder groups. Exceptional communication and influencing skills; ability to translate complex scientific and technical content into clear, patient-friendly messaging and compelling executive presentations. Patient-first mindset combined with commercial acumen; demonstrated passion for improving patient health outcomes and healthcare system innovation. Fluency in both English and Mandarin (written and spoken) required. The role focuses on coordinating and executing cybersecurity, network, and infrastructure activities in line with established standards and governance to protect critical digital assets and ensure reliable plant operations. The Team Member performs day‑to‑day operations, lifecycle, and support activities across cybersecurity and network domains ensuring resilient, secure, and optimized Digital and Automation systems. The role works closely with the Cyber Security & Network Lead, the global Cyber Security Team and cross‑functional partners to support secure infrastructure operations, incident response, and continuous improvement at site level. The Cyber & Infrastructure Technology Senior Analyst provides technical guidance within defined scope and contributes to improving cybersecurity and infrastructure practices, escalating where required. Role Description Responsibilities Governance, Regulations & Standards Execute all work in alignment with applicable quality, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements; follow established SOPs and governance processes; identify and escalate deviations or risks as required. Support inspections, audits, and assessments by providing accurate documentation, data, and technical input when requested. Coordinate and contribute to cybersecurity regulations and standards application, enhancing deployment and adherence across assigned systems. Architecture, Controls & Cybersecurity Delivery Execute defined site-level cybersecurity and network activities in accordance with established Digital and Automation architecture, cybersecurity, and network standards. Enhance implementation and effectiveness of approved control strategies and tools to maintain secure and compliant Digital and Automation environments. Contribute to vulnerability remediation activities and improving control effectiveness and risk mitigation approaches. Enhance cybersecurity planning, monitoring, and control tools by providing technical input, execution feedback, and documentation in line with approved strategies and standards. Participate in local or global cybersecurity, infrastructure, and Digital & Automation–related projects as an executing team member. Operations, Monitoring & Lifecycle Optimize day-to-day Digital and Automation infrastructure operations, including proactive monitoring, incident handling, and issue resolution for assigned systems and network components as well as user management and audit trail reviews.  Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service.  
 Role Responsibilities:   
 Collaborate with Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers] in installing, maintaining, and upgrading customer equipment
 Use digital analytics for troubleshooting   
 Apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess equipment and address technical issues, with guidance from Senior Field Service Engineers [Customer Engineers]
 Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems (training provided)
 Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
 Fulfill additional duties, as assigned
 Minimum Qualifications:   
 Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification
 1–2 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics
 Experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical challenges
 Basic mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, or thermodynamics
 Familiarity with hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols
 Preferred Qualifications:   
 2–4 years of work experience in customer/field service support, or a related technical field
 Required Education:  
 Minimum of an Associate's Degree
 Physical Requirements:   
This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.   Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

Job Purpose and Impact 
 The Senior Director, China SMT Lead will provide strategic leadership for the Strategic Marketing and Technology function in ANH China. In this role, you will lead the development and execution of market strategies, portfolio priorities, innovation pipelines and technology agendas to deliver business growth, customer value and stronger market competitiveness. You will collaborate with business leaders, commercial teams, technology teams and global SMT partners to align priorities, enable execution and build organizational capability.
 Key Accountabilities 
 Lead the development and execution of ANH China market strategies, including segmentation, growth priorities, value propositions and required capabilities.
 Partner with business leadership to align strategic priorities, portfolio choices, go-to-market plans, channel strategies and pricing execution.
 Develop and manage product, service and solution portfolios and innovation pipelines that support customer needs, growth objectives and financial performance.
 Translate market and customer insights into technology priorities, resource allocation decisions and research and development focus areas.
 Develop business cases and annual plans for new products, services and solutions, and monitor progress against growth, EBIDA and annual operating plan targets.
 Lead, coach and develop the SMT team, building strong collaboration, inclusive leadership, talent pipelines and effective ways of working.
 Qualifications 
 Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, animal nutrition, science, technology or a related field, or equivalent experience.
 Minimum of relevant experience in strategic marketing, business strategy, portfolio management, product line management or a related field.
 Demonstrated experience developing market strategies, go-to-market plans, customer segmentation and innovation or portfolio priorities.
 Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to connect market insights, customer needs and financial outcomes.
 Proven ability to influence senior leaders and collaborate across commercial, technology, finance and operations teams.
 Confirmed people leadership skills, including the ability to build inclusive, collaborative and high-performing teams.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience working with global strategy frameworks, annual operating planning, value proposition development and portfolio governance.
 Experience leading innovation pipelines, new product, service and solution development, and cross-functional launch execution.
 Knowledge of ANH markets, customer segments, competitive dynamics and industry trends.
 Demonstrated ability to build strong networks and collaborate effectively across local, regional and global teams.

职责概述 助理医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递 / 沟通 / 反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 1. 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 2. 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 3. 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 4. 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 5. 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 6. 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 7. 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会。 8. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 · 教育： - 具有《医药代表管理办法》（包括不时的修订）要求的医学、药学或相关专业大学专科及以上学历。 · 技能： - 熟练使用 MS Office ，英语良好。 - 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 · 经验 ： - 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 · 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA ( 《反海外腐败法》 ) 及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透 明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 · 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级 & 时限等要求。 核心能力 专业合规 : 坚持专业推广 - 掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规 - 工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断 : 把握市场动态 - 随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息 - 合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动 : 提供专业支持 - 积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作 - 对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行 : 高效准确执行 - 及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务 - 对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 自我发展 : 主动提升能力 - 把握内外部各种学习机会和资源，不断提升自身的能力和适应力。 创新变革 : 积极拥抱变化 - 用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers .

职责概述 医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递/沟通/反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会。 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 教育： 具有《医药代表管理办法》（包括不时的修订）要求的医学、药学或相关专业大学专科及以上学历。 技能： 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 经验： 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 诚信： 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 内部申请资格： 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等要求。 核心能力 专业合规: 坚持专业推广-掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规-工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断: 把握市场动态-随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息-合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动: 提供专业支持-积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作-对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行: 高效准确执行-及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务-对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 自我发展: 主动提升能力-把握内外部各种学习机会和资源，不断提升自身的能力和适应力。 创新变革: 积极拥抱变化-用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers .

jobs.job_description_raw:
Why Patients Need You Pfizer's marketing and market research teams position our product portfolio to meet the needs of patients and health care providers. Whether you are involved in marketing, planning, forecasting, or implementation, your contribution will be important to understanding patients’ needs and the market insights so that we can create value that changes patients’ lives. What You Will Achieve You will be in an important and exciting role of providing marketing direction for Pfizer’s wide array of products. Your coordination skills will be helpful in managing the marketing plan and launching programs to create demand for product lines. You will evaluate brand performance periodically and recommend product development or enhancement as well as oversee development of marketing material. Your leadership skills will be useful to provide direction to the sales force for activities, such as advertising, public relations and product strategy implementation to achieve product marketing objectives. As a Manager, you provide guidance to operational teams for managing projects. Your planning skills will help in preparing forecasts for resource requirements, and providing areas of improvement for products, processes or services. Through your comprehensive knowledge of principles, concepts and theories of the discipline, you will also work towards advancing new concepts and methodologies. You will be able to take a leadership role to facilitate agreements between different teams. It is your hard work and focus that will make Pfizer ready to achieve new milestones and help patients across the globe. How You Will Achieve It • Provide guidance, lead/co-lead projects, manage own time to meet objectives and plan resource requirements for projects across the division. • Lead the development of the business plan for the in-market and pipeline products. • Manage strategy development and execution to maximize revenues. • Develop awareness campaigns, congress content in partnership with the Medical team. • Develop channel specific customer segmentation and go-to-market models, Life-cycle Management plan for Brand or Portfolio. • Select best fitting modules for local needs for campaign development. • Manage cross-functional brand leadership across Field Force, Account management, medical, legal, regulatory, etc. • Lead in-country cross-functional team and work in collaboration with global cross-functional teams in order to coordinate the activities of these teams to achieve brand objectives. • Forecast brand performance and track progress towards target. • Manage local agencies for trans-creation and validate brand-specific messages, design training. • Ensure that customer and patient insights as well as market issues are well understood and processed into the local and European business plans. • Drive market intelligence gathering initiatives for existing and new products by liaising with the sales teams and market research agencies. Qualifications • Bachelor's Degree is required, Master degree or MBA is preferred； • Innovation ability in Programs； • Clinical Medicine/Pharmacy/Biology/Chemistry/Pharmaceutical manicuring related majors is preferred; • At least 5 years working experience in Pharmaceutical industry； • Experience of managing revenues and costs is required; • Knowledge of Marketing Mix principles, business acumen and marketing execution is must have; • Preferred demonstrated initiative, strong strategic and leadership skills; • Track record of working collaboratively across functions; • Product management experience; • Fluent in written and spoken English is required; • Advanced Microsoft Office capabilities, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word is must have. Work Location Assignment: On Premise Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. jobs.job_description_raw:
Development China Translational Medicine Scientist combines the understanding of disease biology with prior experience in clinical trial sample analyses to design, prioritize and successfully execute clinical translational studies that will inform key drug development decisions in the era of precision medicine. The China Translational medicine scientist may act as point of contact to expedite study start-up and conduct and to support biomarker assay transfer, compliance and overall study quality. Responsibilities: Design, conduct and coordinate clinical biomarker analysis related activities involved in Pfizer Oncology and non-oncology portfolio, focusing on pharmacodynamic proof-of-mechanism/pharmacology, patient selection/stratification and clinical proof-of-concept (POC), and underlying disease biology of relevance to combination therapy and drug sensitivity or resistance. Conduct and coordinate activities related to identify and evaluate candidate predictive biomarkers and develop clinical companion diagnostic tests that will appropriately transition from early to late phase clinical development. Work directly with a variety of external contract research organizations/vendors as well as academic collaborators and key opinion leaders to execute clinical biomarker analysis efforts. Work collaboratively within highly integrated, multi-functional program teams that includes Translational Oncology, Precision Medicine, Clinical Pharmacology and Development Operations groups, as well as Clinicians, Statisticians, and Asset Team Leads. Technical / Behavioral Competencies: Technical Competencies Clinical Project Expertise: demonstrated potential or ability to initiate and conduct clinical studies focusing on executing biomarker analyses that support clinical development objectives Scientific Excellence: demonstrated understanding of pre-clinical and clinical disease biology, and the ability to apply that knowledge to drug development; demonstrated understanding of the complexities and recent developments in the relevant therapeutic/technical area, and the ability to apply such knowledge to drug development Presentation and Analytical Skills: demonstrates ability to present biomarker data, study plans and tactics clearly and accurately to relevant audiences to obtain decision Behavioral Competencies Networking and Alliance Building: Able to work across many interfaces: clinical-regulatory; clinical-marketing; clinical-project management; clinical-development operations (biometrics, monitoring resource, study reporting) Influencing: be able to manage and motivate contract research organizations Innovation: Constantly challenge existing paradigms in clinical research and encourage breakthrough designs; work with clinical development operations on study design, data capture and retrieval, reporting Courage with decisiveness to Act: Bias towards action to achieving goals Conflict Management: Good at focused listening; can find common ground and get cooperation with minimum noise Qualifications (Training, Education & Prior Experience): Education: Preferred PhD . Postgraduate training/certification /fellowship in a medical discipline or in drug development with focus on disease biology and biomarkers. Candidates should possess understanding of cancer biology, cancer genetics and immunology, and demonstrate scientific productivity (e.g. doctoral thesis, publications, research reports, etc.) Prior Experience: Had experience in executing and interpreting studies of cancer biomarkers in clinical trials, including biomarker development, validation, and clinical application; familiarity with clinical trial design, logistics and regulatory issues; familiarity with the development and regulatory approval of oncology companion diagnostics. Demonstrated ability to work well in collaborative, multi-disciplinary team setting; effective verbal and written communication skills #LI-PFE Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
