职责概述 医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递/沟通/反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会。 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 教育： 具有《医药代表管理办法》（包括不时的修订）要求的医学、药学或相关专业大学专科及以上学历。 技能： 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 经验： 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 诚信： 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 内部申请资格： 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等要求。 核心能力 专业合规: 坚持专业推广-掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规-工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断: 把握市场动态-随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息-合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动: 提供专业支持-积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作-对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行: 高效准确执行-及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务-对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 自我发展: 主动提升能力-把握内外部各种学习机会和资源，不断提升自身的能力和适应力。 创新变革: 积极拥抱变化-用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers .

Who We Are 
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
 What We Offer

Beijing,CHN, Chengdu,CHN, Hefei,CHN, Shanghai,CHN, Shenzhen,CHN, Wuxi,CHN

We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

Role Summary: The Development China Clinician is responsible for high quality and timely delivery of one or more interventional clinical trials for R&D. They apply technical excellence in the design of cost-efficient clinical trials to meet the needs of internal and external customers, ensure effective conduct and medical/scientific oversight of studies (in partnership with CTM) and support appropriate interpretation and communication of clinical trial data (including high quality regulatory submissions and product defense activities). They ensure compliance with internal and external standards, proactively mitigate risk and manage emerging clinical issues. The China Clinician may act as a site liaison and point of contact to expedite study start-up and conduct and to support clinical training, compliance and overall study quality. Responsibilities: Clinical Trials Co-chairs clinical study team and works collaboratively with other study team members. Point of accountability to the BU for design, conduct, interpretation and reporting of one or more clinical studies (or elements of those studies). Provides clinical and scientific expertise to the clinical trial strategy and protocol development process, including acquisition of knowledge of competitor products. Through application of Enhanced Clinical Trial Design (ECTD)/ Enhanced Quantitative Drug Development (EQDD), ensures the most efficient clinical protocols are developed. Designs/writes clinical trial outlines, protocols and amendments, in collaboration with internal contributors (e.g. statisticians, Outcomes Research(OR) specialists, clinical pharmacologists, clinical project managers, Regional Clinical Site Leads (RCSLs), market access colleagues, commercial development colleagues), internal experts (e.g. clinical program lead, global clinical lead, global clinical strategy lead), and external experts (e.g. investigators, key opinion leaders, advisory board members); ensures design is consistent with objectives. Proactive in authoring efficient protocols that minimize the likelihood of amendments. Identifies and assesses study risks to good clinical practices, subject rights/safety and data integrity throughout protocol development and study conduct; creates, implements and assesses effectiveness of mitigation plans. Provides clinical input to Study Team for monitoring guidelines, iq RAMP, statistical analysis plans, informed consent documents, clinical review forms, data edit checks, data quality planning, Regional Medical Monitor - Medical Oversight Plan as needed (ultimately oversees work of Study Team). Contributes to CRO / vendor selection to ensure study is conducted consistent with protocol requirements, clinical plan expectations, and study timelines; this includes ensuring medical/technical requirements for data integrity are applied (e.g. lab specifications). Approves selection of countries, clinical sites and investigators with appropriate qualifications, patient populations, and recruitment strategy to meet goals in a timely, high quality and cost effective manner. Ensures study is registered on www.ClinicalTrials.gov, study details are kept up-to-date and basic results are disclosed as required. Creates (and where appropriate, delivers) clinical/protocol training materials for study and site management and for use during site initiation visits and investigator meetings. Helps establish and oversees Data Monitoring Committees (DMCs) and endpoint adjudication committees, including chartering, contracts, provision of relevant data and documentation of outcomes. Jointly accountable with study team for study enrollment and adherence to agreed timelines for study deliverables. Maintains direct contact with investigative sites through site visits, telephone contacts, email etc., in order to facilitate investigator engagement, address investigator questions regarding the protocol or the investigational product, and support enrolment activities. This is done in conjunction with RCSLs (when assigned) for sites outside US, Canada, Japan and China. For some studies the clinician may take on an expanded role as described below for the site liaison responsibilities. Consistent with Safety Review Plan (SRP), performs and documents regular review of individual subject safety data and cumulative safety data with the safety risk lead (as delegated by the China Clinical Program Lead or the Global Clinical Lead). For all studies, clinical safety review should be performed in consultation with a designated medically-qualified Medical Monitor. Responsible for identifying emerging safety trends and raising them forward for further discussion with the Clinical Program Lead and/or Global Clinical Lead; follows up with investigators for specific safety findings (e.g. SAEs). Reviews and manages protocol deviations. Works with study team to ensure high quality of data, e.g. appropriate patient population, adequacy of clinical assessments etc., as study is ongoing. Conducts clinical review and interpretation of efficacy and safety data from clinical trials; this includes delivery of top-line report in collaboration with study statistician, and delivery of clinical study report in collaboration with medical writer; accountable for overall quality and timeliness of analysis and reporting. Responsible for clinical and scientific validity of study report, especially conclusions regarding efficacy and safety. Responsible for disclosure of appropriate safety and efficacy data and conclusions. Ensures narrative strategy for clinical trial(s) is consistent with program narrative strategy; writes (or oversees writingof) safety narratives. Assists in ensuring regulatory compliance for clinical trials and reporting. Contributes to primary publication of clinical trial results. May act as primary contact with external investigators and internal study team for questions relating to the clinical/medical aspects of the protocol. Responsible for keeping the Development China Clinical Program Lead and/or Development China Category Development Lead informed of any critical issues relating to benefit:risk evaluation, or study delivery in line with agreed budget, timelines and quality. Presents to internal and external advisory committees (e.g. Technical Review Committee, advisory boards) on design of clinical trials and data from clinical trials. Site Liaison Responsibilities (if applicable) The China Clinician may have site liaison responsibilities: Serve as clinical site liaison to support trial conduct through virtual meetings or teleconferences (as appropriate) and essential face-to-face contact, working directly with site staff. Maintain the ‘Face of Pfizer’ at each site. Create and maintain positive relationships and enthusiasm. Understand the work environment and key relationships at clinical sites, use analytical and influencing skills to improve communications and collaboration between key stakeholders. Ensure site staff have thorough understanding of protocol requirements (technical and logistic), partner with site staff and study team members to overcome feasibility barriers and operational obstacles and ensure successful subject recruitment/enrollment/retention, protocol compliance and clinical trial quality. Conduct frank discussions and set clear expectations for site performance and monitor site performance through metrics. Identify quality issues and discuss with Pfizer clinical/operations study team members so that corrective actions may be instituted. Escalate protocol-related issues requiring medical expertise to the RCSL or medically-qualified China Clinical Program Lead, if needed. Escalate operational issues to the appropriate operations study team member. Identify the need for and provide supportive coaching and/or training to site staff, as appropriate. Identify methods, techniques, key relationships and logistic approaches employed by most successful sites and translate/transfer these best practices to aspiring sites. General Motivates and engages colleagues in an understanding of disease and commitment and excitement to an indication and mechanism. Coaches and mentors less experienced clinicians; may directly manage clinicians. Maintains and enhances knowledge in relevant disease area and/or technical area (e.g. pediatrics, regional clinical trials) and practice guidelines relevant to the regions in which clinical trials are being conducted. Interfaces with other Pfizer sites, other BUs and other functions to develop and share best practices, as appropriate. May organize expert panel, consultant or advisory board meetings to provide input to protocols, clinical plans or data analysis. Provides clinical assistance regarding Scientific and Commercialization Support (SCS) for approved medicines, co-promotions, product defense, and clinical consultation on epidemiology and OR studies. Assists in the development of publications, abstracts, and/or presentations. Leads or assists in the preparations of the clinical content of regulatory submissions/documents (e.g. NDA, MAA, IND, sNDA, IB, AR). Assists in discussions with regulators and with the resolution of queries from drug regulatory agencies / ethics committees; leads or contributes to writing and review responses to regulatory queries. May support technical review of licensing opportunities, including due diligence activities. Ensures compliance with global and local training requirements and adherence to relevant global / local clinical and medical controlled documents (CMCDs). Contributes to (or leads) continuous improvement activities, and to education and training of clinical staff in areas of competence/experience. Ensure all creative outputs demonstrate strong visual quality, brand consistency, medical communication relevance, and alignment with business objectives. Design Team Leadership: Lead, manage, and coach the design team. Project Management Excellence: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple design projects simultaneously, prioritize resources effectively, and ensure high-quality delivery under fast-paced timelines. Job Purpose and Impact 
 This role partners closely with traders, commercial teams, and global analytics teams to support decision making in dynamic agricultural commodity markets.
 Beyond strong analytical capability, success requires intellectual curiosity, a growth mindset, adaptability, effective communication, and sound judgment under uncertainty.
 The analyst is expected to connect data, market intelligence, industry insights, and stakeholder perspectives, transforming information into actionable insights that support trading and business decisions.
 The role also includes customer visits, market surveys, industry research, and cross-functional project participation, providing opportunities to develop a deep understanding of agricultural value chains and real-world market dynamics.   
 Please be notice that this role will requires 2-months internship assessment period. 
 Key Accountabilities 
 1. Market Data and Industry Intelligence 
 Continuously collect, track, and explore key market data and industry intelligence across the agricultural value chain, drawing on commercial teams, customers, industry participants, public sources etc.
 Transform market information into structured data and analytical materials, cross-validating data, assumptions, and market intelligence to ensure accuracy and consistency.
 Maintain well-organized and reusable data assets in local or global databases to support ongoing analysis, trading activities, and future AI-enabled workflows.
 2. Fundamental & Trading Analysis 
 Maintain and update supply and demand balances for relevant agricultural commodities and contribute to fundamental market analysis.
 Monitor domestic and international price movements, trade flows, margins, and other key market indicators, and contribute to price and scenario analysis.
 Identify key market drivers, structural trends, uncertainties, and potential risks, and assess their implications for supply and demand, prices, and trading decisions.
 Synthesize data, industry intelligence, and stakeholder perspectives to develop independent market views and actionable insights.
 Build a solid understanding of agricultural value chains and market mechanisms, and progressively develop analytical frameworks and methodologies that can be reused across different market situations.
 3. Team Collaboration & Research Ownership 
 Maintain close communication with traders and relevant teams, engage in discussions on market developments, and provide analytical input
 Take ownership of assigned research topics and projects, driving work from problem definition and analytical design through execution, iterative communication, and delivery of actionable conclusions.
 Qualifications 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Intellectual curiosity about agricultural commodity markets, industries, and real-world business dynamics, with a strong motivation to learn continuously.
 Strong logical and analytical capability, with the ability to structure complex problems, identify key drivers, synthesize diverse information, and form sound judgments under uncertainty.
 Strong learning agility and adaptability, with the ability to incorporate new information, technology, feedback, and changing market conditions into the analytical process.
 Strong data literacy and attention to detail, with the ability to work with structured and unstructured information in a rigorous and organized manner.
 Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into concise and actionable messages.
 Ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment and contribute constructively to team outcomes.
 Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and execution discipline.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Academic background in Data Science & AI, Finance, Agricultural Economics, International Trade, Engineering, Science, or other related disciplines.
 Familiarity with data analysis, visualization, data processing, and generative AI tools, with the ability to leverage technology to improve research efficiency, organize information, and support analytical workflows.
 Relevant internship, project, research, or extracurricular experience in agriculture, commodities, market intelligence, economics, trading, data analysis, or related fields.

Position Overview The AI Transformation Strategy & Operation Lead is a senior leadership role responsible for establishing, strategy governing, and orchestrating Pfizer China’s portfolio of AI-driven transformation initiatives within the GTM Transformation Team. Reporting directly to the GTM Transformation Lead, this role serves as the strategic nerve center for all AI transformation programs, ensuring governance rigor, cross-functional alignment, delivery excellence, and measurable business impact. The incumbent will work at the intersection of enterprise strategy, artificial intelligence, and commercial operations, accelerating Pfizer China’s position as a leader in AI-enabled healthcare transformation. Key Responsibilities Strategy & Framework Establish and maintain a comprehensive AI transformation strategy & governance framework, including standards, methodologies, templates, and processes that ensure consistency, quality, and auditability across all transformation programs. Define and operationalize end-to-end program lifecycle management practices — from initiative intake and scoping through execution, launch, and value realization. Portfolio Management Oversee and manage the AI transformation project portfolio, ensuring initiatives are strategically prioritized, resourced, and tracked against defined OKRs and KPIs aligned with Pfizer China’s GTM transformation strategy. Maintain a consolidated portfolio view, identifying interdependencies, sequencing initiatives, and flagging bottlenecks or risks to ensure cohesive, on-schedule delivery. Senior Stakeholder Management Serve as the primary liaison between the GTM Transformation Team and senior leadership, BU leads, digital, CEI, and external partners, ensuring transparent communication, alignment, and sustained executive sponsorship. Facilitate steering committee meetings, governance forums, and cross-functional alignment sessions, driving accountability and decision-making efficiency at all levels. Transformation Roadmap Develop and maintain the integrated AI transformation roadmap, incorporating strategic priorities, resource constraints, and emerging opportunities to guide multi-year transformation execution. Continuously refresh the roadmap in response to business developments, regulatory changes, and technology advancements in the AI landscape. Performance Reporting Design and deliver executive-level dashboards, progress reports, and strategic updates that communicate transformation milestones, risks, and business value realization to senior leadership and the Board. Establish clear metrics and success criteria for all transformation programs, enabling data-driven portfolio decisions and course corrections. Resource & Budget Governance Optimize resource allocation across the transformation portfolio, managing workforce planning, vendor engagement, and budget deployment to maximize program impact. Partner with Finance to manage transformation budgets, track spend against plan, and develop business cases for new investment decisions. Risk & Issue Management Proactively identify, assess, escalate, and mitigate risks and issues across transformation programs, maintaining a live risk register and proposing resolution pathways in a timely manner. Foster a risk-aware culture within the transformation team, embedding structured risk reviews into governance cadences. Change Management & AI Culture Drive organizational change management initiatives that foster a culture of AI innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning within the GTM Transformation Team and across commercial functions. Develop and execute communication and engagement plans that build AI literacy, adoption readiness, and transformation momentum across the organization. Compliance & Standards Ensure all transformation initiatives comply with Pfizer’s global standards, data privacy regulations (including PIPL), and local regulatory requirements. Maintain the highest standards of ethics, professional conduct, and risk management to safeguard Pfizer’s reputation and regulatory standing. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or above in Business Administration, Management, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field; Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred. Minimum 10 years of professional experience in program/portfolio management, product owner and leadership, strategy consulting, or enterprise transformation roles within multinational or highly regulated environments. Proven track record of establishing and leading enterprise-level program functions or transformation offices, with demonstrated ability to govern large, complex, cross-functional programs from inception to value realization. Strong understanding of AI technologies, digital transformation methodologies, and their commercial applications in the pharmaceutical or life sciences sector. Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leadership and C-suite stakeholders; excellent executive communication, influencing, and facilitation skills. Expertise in change management frameworks and organizational development, with a track record of driving successful adoption of complex transformations. Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with a structured, data-driven approach to portfolio decision-making. PMP, PgMP, Agile/SAFe, or equivalent program management certification preferred. Fluency in both English and Mandarin (written and spoken) required. Experience in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences industry is highly desirable. Key Competencies Strategic Leadership & Vision Governance & Portfolio Management Executive Stakeholder Engagement & Influence AI & Digital Transformation Literacy Change Management & Organizational Development Results Orientation & Accountability Cross-functional Collaboration & Integration Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. To enable launch excellence, strengthen pre-launch readiness and clarify strategic direction, the Launch Excellence Lead (Sr. Marketing Manager) role will be established. From a business perspective, this role will lead pre-launch preparation before the Brand Lead is fully onboarded. The role will serve as the key business interface for product-related matters, work closely with CSI, Market Access, Medical, Marketing, Supply, Regulatory and Global teams, ensure critical milestones are achieved on time or accelerated, and enable a smooth transition to the future Brand Lead. Role and Responsibility • Lead pre-launch planning and readiness for ORBU new products before Brand Lead onboarding, including workplan, timeline and key deliverables. • Serve as the key business interface for new product-related matters, driving cross-functional communication, issue resolution and resource coordination. • Partner with CSI, Market Access, Medical, Marketing, Supply, Regulatory and Global teams to align launch strategy, approval pathway, access strategy, evidence plan, supply readiness and commercialization plan. • Drive critical launch milestones, proactively identify risks, dependencies and acceleration opportunities, and establish escalation and decision-making mechanisms. • Develop initial product strategy, market assessment and mid-to-long-term forecast model based on market insights, competitive dynamics, patient journey and business opportunities. • Support business case development, prioritization and resource allocation recommendations to inform management decisions. • Establish launch governance, including project cadence, cross-functional meetings, action tracking, risk management and key decision documentation. • Ensure a structured handover to the Brand Lead once onboarded, including strategic direction, project status, key risks, stakeholder map and next-step actions. Professional Qualification & Skills • 8+ years of healthcare/pharmaceutical industry experience; NPP, new product planning or consulting experience is preferred. • Proven new product launch experience in marketing or commercial roles, with solid understanding of key processes from early planning to launch readiness. • Ability to independently develop product strategy, market assessment and mid-to-long-term forecast models, with strong business acumen and analytical capability. • Oncology experience is preferred. • Fluent written and verbal English communication skills, with ability to collaborate effectively with Global teams. • Strong cross-functional communication, coordination and influencing skills, with ability to drive alignment and action in a matrix organization without direct reporting authority. • Strong project management capability, with ability to independently manage multiple complex projects and deliver key milestones on time. • Strong structured thinking, problem-solving and risk anticipation capabilities. • Proficient in PowerPoint, Excel and other office tools; strong forecast modeling and business analysis capability. Added Value • Improve the systematic planning, foresight and execution efficiency of ORBU new product pre-launch readiness. • Fill the critical business leadership gap before the Brand Lead is onboarded and reduce preparation downtime. • Strengthen alignment between China and Global teams on strategy, evidence, resources and timelines. • Improve cross-functional collaboration efficiency and decision quality through consistent project governance and risk management. • Help ORBU identify launch opportunities and potential risks earlier, and drive critical milestones to be achieved on time or accelerated. Who We Are 
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. 
 What We Offer 
 Location:
Hsinchu,TWN, Shanghai,CHN, Tainan,TWN 
 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 
 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . 
 Position Summary 
 As part of a centralized Employee Relations (ER) Center of Excellence, this role serves as a trusted advisor to business leaders, HR Business Partners, Global Employment Law (GEL), and cross-functional stakeholders on complex employee relations matters. The position is responsible for independently leading workplace investigations, performance and conduct management cases, and employee risk mitigation efforts while ensuring compliance with employment laws, company policies, and organizational values. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in employee relations investigations, performance management, stakeholder consultation, and labor law compliance within a multinational environment. This individual must be comfortable navigating sensitive and high-risk situations, influencing senior leaders, and balancing employee, legal, and business considerations.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Employee Relations & Investigations 
 Lead end-to-end employee relations investigations from intake through fact-finding, interviews, evidence analysis, findings, recommendations, and case closure.
 Handle complex and sensitive matters, including harassment, discrimination, retaliation, workplace misconduct, conflicts of interest, ethics concerns, and policy violations.
 Conduct independent investigations and prepare clear, objective, and well-documented investigation reports and recommendations.
 Partner closely with Global Employment Law, Ethics & Compliance, Security, and HR stakeholders on high-risk or escalated employee matters.
 Assess legal, reputational, operational, and employee-related risks and provide recommendations to support informed decision-making.
 Performance & Conduct Management 
 Serve as a subject matter expert on employee performance, conduct, disciplinary actions, and involuntary separations.
 Advise and coach managers on difficult employee situations, including performance improvement plans (PIPs), misconduct investigations, corrective actions, and terminations.
 Ensure consistent and legally compliant application of policies and employment practices across employee populations.
 Support leaders in managing complex performance and behavior-related concerns while balancing business objectives and employee experience.
 Consultation, Partnership & Coaching 
 Act as a trusted advisor to HRBPs and business leaders on employee relations strategy, risk management, and workplace conflict resolution.
 Influence and coach leaders at all organizational levels through complex and sensitive employee situations.
 Partner effectively with HR Centers of Excellence, Legal, Compliance, Security, and regional HR teams to drive consistent employee relations practices.
 Foster productive relationships across diverse cultures and stakeholder groups within a matrixed global organization.
 Global Collaboration & Compliance 
 Support employee relations matters involving regional and global stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions.
 Interpret and apply employment laws, regulations, and company policies to ensure compliant business practices.
 Prepare professional reports, business communications, and case summaries for regional and global leadership audiences.
 Monitor external labor and employment trends and recommend proactive risk mitigation strategies.
 Data, Metrics & Continuous Improvement 
 Track and analyze ER case metrics, trends, root causes, and organizational risks.
 Identify opportunities to improve employee relations processes, policies, governance, and manager effectiveness.
 Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance investigation quality, case management, and employee experience.
 Training & Enablement 
 Develop and deliver training programs for managers, HR teams, and stakeholders on employee relations, investigations, performance management, and workplace conduct.
 Build organizational capability in managing employee issues proactively and consistently.
 Partner with GEL and HR stakeholders to enhance ER-related tools, resources, and manager readiness.
 Skills & Competencies 
 Advanced workplace investigation and fact-finding skills.
 Strong expertise in employee relations, performance management, and conduct management.
 Exceptional consulting, influencing, stakeholder management, and coaching capabilities.
 Sound judgment and demonstrated ability to balance legal, employee, and business risks.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare investigation reports and executive-level recommendations.
 Ability to manage highly sensitive and confidential matters with discretion and professionalism.
 Executive presence with the ability to influence leaders in complex and ambiguous situations.
 Collaborative, culturally agile, and effective in multinational and matrixed environments.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify patterns, root causes, and organizational risks.
 Demonstrated learning agility, resilience, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
 Knowledge & Experience 
 Required 
 7+ years of Employee Relations, Labor Relations, Workplace Investigations, Employment Law, or related HR experience.
 Demonstrated experience independently conducting complex workplace investigations.
 Strong experience supporting performance management, disciplinary actions, misconduct cases, and involuntary separations.
 Experience partnering with Legal, Compliance, HR, and business leaders on high-risk employee matters.
 Strong knowledge of labor and employment laws and HR compliance requirements.
 Experience working in a multinational corporation or complex matrix organization.
 Professional level English communication and business writing skills.
 Preferred 
 Experience supporting Greater China operations, including knowledge of both Taiwan and China labor regulations.
 Semiconductor, technology, manufacturing, or other fast-paced multinational industry experience.
 Experience working with regional or global employee relations programs.
 Background in Employment Law, Labor Relations, Compliance, Workplace Investigations, or ER Center of Excellence structures.
 Success Profile 
 The successful candidate is a seasoned Employee Relations professional who can independently lead complex investigations, navigate sensitive employee issues, influence senior leaders, and provide practical business-focused solutions while maintaining the highest standards of fairness, compliance, and integrity.

Full time

Assignee / Regular

Yes, 10% of the Time

Yes

jobs.job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递/沟通/反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 1. 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 2. 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 3. 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 4. 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 5. 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 6. 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 7. 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会。 8. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 · 教育： - 大学本科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 · 技能： - 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 - 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 · 经验： - 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 · 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 · 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等要求。 核心能力 专业合规: 坚持专业推广-掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规-工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断: 把握市场动态-随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息-合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动: 提供专业支持-积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作-对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行: 高效准确执行-及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务-对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 自我发展: 主动提升能力-把握内外部各种学习机会和资源，不断提升自身的能力和适应力。 创新变革: 积极拥抱变化-用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. jobs.job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递 / 沟通 / 反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 1. 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 2. 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 3. 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 4. 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 5. 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 6. 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 7. 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会。 8. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 · 教育： - 大学本科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 · 技能： - 熟练使用 MS Office ，英语良好。 - 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 · 经验： - 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 · 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA ( 《反海外腐败法 》 ) 及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款 。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 · 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级 & 时限等要求。 核心能力 专业合规 : 坚持专业推广 - 掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规 - 工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断 : 把握市场动态 - 随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息 - 合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动 : 提供专业支持 - 积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作 - 对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行 : 高效准确执行 - 及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务 - 对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 自我发展 : 主动提升能力 - 把握内外部各种学习机会和资源，不断提升自身的能力和适应力。 创新变革 : 积极拥抱变化 - 用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. jobs.job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递/沟通/反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 1. 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 2. 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 3. 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 4. 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 5. 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 6. 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 7. 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会。 8. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 · 教育： - 大学本科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 · 技能： - 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 - 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 · 经验： - 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 · 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 · 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等要求。 核心能力 专业合规: 坚持专业推广-掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规-工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断: 把握市场动态-随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息-合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动: 提供专业支持-积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作-对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行: 高效准确执行-及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务-对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 自我发展: 主动提升能力-把握内外部各种学习机会和资源，不断提升自身的能力和适应力。 创新变革: 积极拥抱变化-用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. jobs.job_description_raw: 职 责 概 述 医学信息沟通大区经理负责管理所辖区域的一切业务，包括制订和实施区域的业务目标和发展计划，建立一个业绩良好、极富生产力和士气高昂的团队。对客户的需求做出适当反应以达成或超越区域的各项业务目标。对团队成员的行为进行规范和监管，对他们的专业技能提升和学习发展规划提供辅导和支持。 主 要 工 作 和 任 务 1. 制订并执行所辖区域的业务计划，推动大区各个团队完成或超越完成公司和上级下达的各项工作目标和任务。 2. 招聘符合公司基本要求的人员，定期对团队成员进行绩效和行为的评估，实施奖惩或激励措施。 3. 制订并执行培养团队成员合规意识的计划，规范员工的工作行为，确保各项活动的真实性和合规性。 4. 制订并执行团队成员专业知识和技能的发展计划，通过随访对团队成员定期进行教导，以加强其业务能力、产品知识、产品策略、销售技巧和总体工作效率，并对其个人发展规划提供指导与支持。 5. 根据大区业务发展的方向进行人力资源分配和人才规划，促进区域健康良性发展，建立人才梯队，保留高绩效人才。 6. 通过跟进计划，各团队的工作汇报和和随访等，深入了解各个团队的工作进展并进行针对性的辅导，包括销售及市场活动，人员管理和辅导，人才发展和保留等工作。 7. 根据对市场发展趋势的分析，挖掘区域市场机会，打造大区的长期竞争优势。 8. 协调并组织大区内的重要项目及活动，合理分配和控制各项资源。 9. 与区域内关键客户保持持续的沟通，前瞻性预测客户学术需求的变化，建立并持续优化战略合作伙伴关系。 10. 熟悉对当前及未来业务有影响的政策，必要情况下可根据公司的要求，与相关职能部门合作，参与或协调所辖区域的市场准入工作。 11. 建立和保持有效沟通系统，包括定期召开大区会议，定期与上级汇报区域工作进展，与其他部门建立跨部门沟通和合作关系。 12. 为制订和修改销售相关的政策和流程及其他内部政策提供建议，以实现高效率的销售运作。 13. 支持公司的各项创新举措，带领大区各个团队执行新举措，搭建创新平台。 14. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任 职 要 求 教育： - 大学本科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 技能： - 熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。 - 具备较好的相关产品领域的专业知识。 - 具备较强的领导力和战略思维能力。 - 具备较强的沟通，计划，组织和问题解决能力。 - 具备较强的团队合作意识。 - 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 - 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 经验： - 至少3年制药行业同等公司的销售管理工作经验，具备符合合规要求的，优秀的业绩记录。 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合现行合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等的要求。 - 至少有2年辉瑞销售管理工作经验。 - 过去两年的团队销售业绩，达成率&增长率需达到或超过团队平均水平。 核 心 能 力 专业合规: 构建专业体系-在大区内建立专业能力标准体系，通过流程和机制提升团队整体的专业能力。 营造合规氛围-准确理解合规各项规定的意义和原则，培养团队合规意识，规范团队合规行为，防范合规风险。 业务决断: 策略规划业务-策略性地规划大区的业务发展，在抓住市场机会的同时持续打造大区的长期竞争优势。 宏观掌控市场-通过数据分析，通盘掌握大区整体市场的变化，并对市场趋势进行预判。 客户融动 : 优化合作策略-预测大区客户需求的变化，建立战略合作伙伴关系，通过策略性合作提升辉瑞竞争优势。 建立协作机制-建立并优化合作机制，为协作建立共同的目标，并积极推动持续的跨部门沟通和合作。 组织发展: 营造正向氛围-激发团队信息，营造积极的团队氛围。 搭建人才梯队-通过系统的培养体系提升大区人员的能力，搭建人才梯队。 自主执行: 建立执行机制-在大区内建立和推广高效执行的标准和全面管理机制，在系统及机制层面提升执行效果。 勇于全面担责-对于大区的业绩承担最终责任，主动设定挑战性目标促进工作不断优化。 自我发展: 全面完善自我-审视职业理想和目标，寻求和创造学习机会以促进全面素养的提升。 创新变革: 搭建创新平台-主动探索创新和变革的机会，营造创新变革环境，并推动团队变革。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. jobs.job_description_raw: 职责概述 医学信息沟通专员在医学信息沟通地区经理的领导和辅导下，负责所辖区域内的产品学术推广和客户专业支持，如拜访客户传递 /沟通 /反馈药品信息、召开产品学术推广活动等，从而实现工作目标（包括但不限于专业技能、行为、合规及业绩等综合考评目标）。 主要工作和任务 在公司政策和程序指引下向客户提供及时准确的专业支持，建立合作伙伴关系。 在公司政策和程序指引下充分利用资源进行有效的客户拜访，实现工作目标。 在公司政策和程序指引下规划和组织各种学术会议或活动。 通过公司管理系统以及其他合规的渠道和方式，收集市场和客户反馈的信息，进行分析，反馈和建议。 与上级经理，同事和其他部门的业务伙伴保持有效的联络，发现和促进各种合作机会。 在上级经理的辅导下，把握各种学习机会不断提升专业知识和能力。 执行公司推行的各项新举措，在公司政策和程序引导下探索创新和优化的机会。 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 任职要求 教育： - 大学专科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 技能： 熟练使用 MS Office ，英语良好。 具有较强的沟通能力和团队合作意识。 具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 经验 ： - 医药行业相关工作经验优先。 诚信： - 能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透 明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 内部申请资格： - 内部申请人需符合合规调查流程，处分等级& 时限等要求。 核心能力 专业合规 : 坚持专业推广 -掌握并正确运用产品，治疗，疾病领域的知识，面对客户展现专业形象。严格坚守合规 -工作中严格遵从合规要求，及时澄清问题并报告有合规风险的行为。 业务决断 : 把握市场动态 -随时把握市场动态，并且能敏锐地发现学术推广机会。 有效利用信息 -合法合规地收集和运用信息，有理有据地分析并从中挖掘学术推广机会。 客户融动 : 提供专业支持 -积极与外部客户，包括医生，专家和其他合作伙伴进行互动，快速响应客户的学术需求，准确及时地提供专业支持。 主动促进合作 -对内部客户主动沟通，寻求机会促进相互理解，建立合作关系。 自主执行 : 高效准确执行 -及时准确不打折扣地执行各项工作。 主动承担任务 -对待工作认真负责，有始有终，遇到问题主动承担，遇到困难坚持达成目标。 自我发展 : 主动提升能力 -把握内外部各种学习机会和资源，不断提升自身的能力和适应力。 创新变革 : 积极拥抱变化 -用开放的心态面对创新和变化，积极尝试新方法。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. jobs.job_description_raw: WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH You will be part of the East GC Retail Brand Marketing team and collaborate closely with City Marketing, Geo Retail Marketing, Visual Merchandising, EKIN, Merchandising, Nike Direct, Marketplace Partners, Retail Operations, and Consumer Insights teams. Together, you will drive impactful retail experiences, localized storytelling, and consumer engagement across East GC. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a strategic and consumer-focused retail marketer who is passionate about sport, culture, and retail experiences. You'll bring: 3–5 years of experience in Retail Marketing, Brand Marketing, Consumer Marketing, or related fields. Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of retail marketing, consumer behavior, and marketplace trends. Proven project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Ability to turn insights into actionable marketing plans and consumer experiences. Deep knowledge of East GC consumers, retail landscape, and competitive environment. Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. Proficiency in Keynote and Microsoft Office. Fluent in English and Chinese. WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON Seasonal Retail Marketing Lead the planning and execution of seasonal retail marketing programs across East GC. Translate global and geo priorities into locally relevant retail experiences and storytelling. Ensure premium and consistent brand expression across retail touchpoints. City & Consumer Moments Drive retail activations around key city, sport, and cultural moments. Partner with City Marketing teams to create meaningful consumer connections through locally relevant experiences. Lead end-to-end activation planning, execution, and evaluation. Store Marketing Develop marketing plans for priority stores, key business moments, and new store openings. Identify opportunities to elevate consumer experiences and retail productivity. Drive best practices and scalable solutions across the marketplace. Consumer & Marketplace Insights Monitor consumer trends, marketplace dynamics, and competitor activities. Leverage insights to identify opportunities and strengthen marketing effectiveness. Measure program performance and continuously optimize future initiatives. Cross-Functional Partnership Partner with multiple teams to align priorities, timelines, and execution standards. Act as a key retail marketing resource, providing recommendations and solutions to support business objectives.

jobs.job_description_raw: WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are seeking a talented, passionate, and influential Footwear Materials Developer II with the technical expertise to elevate product excellence through materials. You combine strong material knowledge with creative problem-solving to translate design intent into scalable solutions. You thrive in fast-paced environments, build trust across cross-functional teams, and balance innovation, quality, aesthetics, cost, speed, and sustainability throughout the product creation process. In this role, you will help differentiate Nike’s products in the marketplace through materials excellence. WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON As a member of the GC Local Creation Footwear Product Development team, you will lead the development and commercialization of material solutions that deliver on quality, cost, speed, sustainability, and aesthetic objectives, helping bring premium products to market on time and at scale. · Drive material development, testing, commercialization, and implementation from concept through production. · Partner with Local Creation Product, Design, and Development teams to identify risks, resolve material challenges, and enable informed decision-making throughout the development process. jobs.job_description_raw: The Greater China Brand Creative Retail Design team are the stewards of retail innovation in one of Nike’s largest geographies. We combine strategy with creativity, executing immersive physical experiences that connect athletes to the future of sport. We exist at the intersection of brand and commerce, art and science, bringing big ideas to life in retail environments that inspire our athletes. Our team designs holistic Nike store experience - including architecture, permanent and seasonal storytelling - whilst leveraging global brand and retail standards. We obsess over delivering exceptional brand executions across retail WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR ？ Nike seeks a visionary Design Director for our Retail Store Design team in Greater China. A strategic and collaborative leader, you will guide senior design leads and external partners, consistently seeking new possibilities for innovative, athlete-focused retail environments. You create design solutions that authentically represent Nike’s brand standards and elevate the consumer experience. You bring proven experience scaling retail fleets, shaping distinctive brand spaces, and leading cross-functional teams. You easily navigate disciplines such as Architecture, Furniture & Fixtures, Materials, and Environmental Brand application. Passionate about sport, consumers, and design, you clearly illustrate your ideas and confidently lead projects to completion. WHAT WILL YOU WORK ON ？ You will amplify, extend, and execute retail environments across Greater China’s store portfolio. As a forward thinking, detail oriented leader with an architectural mindset, you will set clear direction, develop compelling designs, and establish implementation standards that ensure consistency across execution. You will lead your team to determine the optimal approach for each project, balancing consumer insights, brand vision, and business objectives. You'll effectively communicate design intent to senior stakeholders, produce impactful presentations, and manage production files when necessary. Travel requirements are approximately 10–25%. WHO WILL YOU WORK WITH? Under guidance from Senior Directors and in partnership with Director level peers, you’ll deliver scalable retail solutions. This role combines team development and mentorship with hands-on design oversight, closely collaborating with internal and external design teams. You will leverage established design processes, toolkits, and best practices to ensure timely, budget-conscious, and creatively-aligned project delivery. WHAT YOU BRING 10+ years of architectural and brand design experience, demonstrating creative sophistication in concepts and visual communication, including at least 3 years managing design teams. Bachelor's degree in architecture, interior design, or a related field, or equivalent experience and education. Comprehensive understanding of design processes and advanced proficiency with industry standard design tools and software. Greater China retail industry experience strongly preferred: familiar with local architecture code, regulation, and scalable retail. international experience beneficial. Strong oral and written communication skills in Mandarin and English & proven ability to clearly articulate complex ideas to senior leadership. Proven skill in visual communication, concept development, and ideation. Exceptional relationship building skills, able to foster collaboration across diverse teams and functions. Demonstrated ability to contribute strategically to processes, policies, and decision-making. Proven experience motivating teams, navigating ambiguity, and facilitating effective collaborative decision-making. Passionate about trends in technology, design, art, interactive, and experiential environments.

jobs.job_description_raw: WE ARE ON THE OFFENSE ALWAYS AND WE WIN AS A TEAM Apparel/Accessories Cost & Material team is a function of Converse Global Sourcing and Manufacturing (GSM), which drives product excellence through sustainable cost engineering model. We revolutionize Apparel and Accessories product costing process, serving as both a subject-matter-expert and change leader in Converse Costing. Our roles include: Establish and continuously update cost models, benchmark, fair standard and tools to enable transparent, sustainable and competitive costing for Converse products Collaborate with key stakeholders (Factory Partners, Merch, Product Creation, Planning, Sourcing and other functions) to resolve product costing challenges so as to improve Converse’s overall product margin. Monitor factory costing performance. Drive product cost excellence and best practices through costing process optimization. And report the value captured. Provide useful analytics for cost-related business decision and company strategy. Analyze, track and report cost drivers impact and review with key functions. You will be a key member in Apparel & Accessories GSM to drive the best practice for Converse costing processes and models, and manage the factory cost performance. You will be the direct contact window of Converse Costing to liaise, align and collaborate with the assigned Tier1 & 2 factory partners. You will also serve as the subject-matter expert in costing who closely collaborates with other functional teams including sourcing, planning, product creation, merchandizing teams. Core Accountabilities: Manage and improve factory cost & material performance Analyze the key improvement areas, create strategies and execute plans/projects to drive factories’ improvement in costing competitiveness and accuracy. Design, implement and review the various cost & material matrices and benchmark. Ensure the factories’ transparent and sustainable product costing. As the subject-matter expert, lead other Converse functions to solve the costing & material issues/challenges of the responsible factories. Establish and update the operating model Collect, clarify and analyze the manufacturing information from the responsible factories or market research. Align with the factory partners for the reasonable and sustainable process. Track and report the cost drivers in the framework regularly. Review the impact with the line managers, provide and execute solutions. Design, create and launch the costing tools (e.g. matrices, libraries, calculators) to all related functions and partners for accurate and quick cost assessment. Research and identify cost trends, challenges and risks. Provide useful analytics and suggestions to leadership for costing strategy. Participate into the design and execution of Converse costing framework under the leadership guidance when applicable. Costing & Material Operation Process & System Improvement Drive the system, process and workflow improvement. Plan and execute the related projects with other Converse functions. Lead costing analysts to manage the costing data and system reports in an efficiency way. Maintain cost data accuracy. Good knowledge in Apparel or relevant textile products and manufacturing costs. Industrial Engineering experience is a plus. Strong project management experience. Effective communication and analytical presentation with different stakeholders. Experience in leading and training other teammates. An initiator able to drive change with “can-do” attitude. Good written and verbal communication in English. Mandarin is a plus. Advanced level in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Macro/VBA is a plus.

Develop product strategies, line plans, pricing recommendations, and clear briefs based on consumer, cultural, competitive, and marketplace insights. Guide cross-functional teams toward a strong product point of view, clear priorities, and timely decisions. You will report to the Senior Specialist, Merchandising Business Integration and partner closely with Greater China Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Supply Chain, Commercial/Sales, Digital, and technology teams. You will also collaborate with the Global Business Integration team to support local adoption of global tools and help ensure Greater China requirements and insights are clearly represented. Connect Global & Local · Gather and document Greater China business requirements, user feedback, and data needs for review with the Senior Specialist and Global Business Integration team. · Support testing, issue tracking, communication, and local adoption of global tools and initiatives; escalate gaps or risks with clear supporting detail. · Help translate merchandising strategy into accurate downstream product and channel requirements, including product attributes, assortment rules, pricing and promotional guidance, and order-collection needs. Document, Communicate & Improve · Maintain clear documentation for data definitions, recurring processes, reporting logic, usage guidelines, and standard operating procedures. · Prepare practical communications, reference materials, and training support that help teams use product data, reports, and tools consistently. · Identify repeatable manual work and contribute to standardized, automated, or analytical solutions that improve speed, accuracy, and team productivity. · Support Game Plan gates, calendars, workback timelines, system dependencies, and cross-functional integration and follow-through across seasonal merchandising workflows. This role sits at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, culture, and creative development. You are passionate about crafting narratives that resonate emotionally, translating athlete insights, cultural movements, and brand priorities into compelling stories that come to life across retail, digital, social, experiential, and community platforms. You are equally comfortable developing creative briefs, building narrative frameworks, identifying cultural opportunities, and bring the triumph and teamwork, pace and poetry of sport to storytelling. You are a team player, who can comfortably collaborate with cross-functional teams and agency partners to bring ideas to life. You are able to inspire others and bring people together with the same belief. Most importantly, you believe that great brands don't just tell stories, they build worlds that people want to belong to. WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON As a Senior Professional, Brand Creative Narrative, you will help develop and execute storytelling strategies that strengthen Nike Basketball's connection with athletes and consumers across Greater China. You will: • Develop narrative frameworks, storytelling territories, and creative briefs for Basketball campaigns, athlete initiatives, product launches, and cultural moments. • Support the localization of Global Basketball strategies and creative platforms for Greater China audiences. • Help create and evolve Basketball narrative worlds that connect athletes, products, communities, and experiences into cohesive consumer journeys. • Translate consumer insights, athlete perspectives, and cultural trends into compelling storytelling opportunities. • Partner with Brand Marketing, Sports Marketing, Retail Marketing, Digital, Social, and Creative teams to ensure narrative consistency across consumer touchpoints. • Collaborate with designers, writers, strategists, producers, and external creative partners to bring stories to life. • Ensure all creative work reflects Nike's voice, values, and commitment to serving athletes. • Present narrative recommendations and creative thinking to cross-functional partners and leadership teams. • Continuously identify emerging cultural trends and shifts within basketball, sport, youth culture, and entertainment that can inspire future storytelling opportunities. jobs.responsibilities: 负责家居舒适系统项目全流程管理、项目升级处理、里程碑评审、文档配置和跨方协同。
jobs.qualifications: 工程专业本科及以上；至少 5 年项目管理经验；中文母语水平并能流利使用英语。

jobs.raw_title: Principal Product Manager - AI, Amazon Global Selling - PMO
jobs.normalized_title_en: Principal Product Manager - AI, Amazon Global Selling - PMO
jobs.job_description_raw: The role leads AI products that transform how China-based global sellers operate and grow on Amazon.
jobs.responsibilities: 定义全球开店 AI 产品战略，推动产品交付、模型评估、负责任 AI 实践与业务效果衡量。
jobs.qualifications: 至少 10 年产品或项目管理、产品营销、业务拓展或技术经验；本科；具备端到端产品交付经验。
